# M02 — I11 Prepare CICIoT2023 Secondary Dataset and Deterministic Pseudo-Domains

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M02 — Validated Dataset and Evidence-Role Preparation
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement secondary raw/schema/label validation, canonicalization, finite predictor handling, deterministic pseudo-domain construction, role reuse, and fixed generalization preparation without retuning primary science.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §5.3
- §11
- §11.1
- §11.2
- §11.3
- §40

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0466–REQ-0472; REQ-0474–REQ-0501; REQ-0503–REQ-0509
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0137; REQ-0510–REQ-0511; REQ-2047–REQ-2048

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement secondary raw/schema/label validation, canonicalization, finite predictor handling, deterministic pseudo-domain construction, role reuse, and fixed generalization preparation without retuning primary science.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0466 — §11 — Configuration:** `datasets.secondary` configuration authority must be limited to the secondary dataset identifier, selected target, and pseudo-domain partition salt.
- **REQ-0467 — §11 — Configuration:** Secondary representation choice, pseudo-domain construction, non-finite handling, no-imputation/no-retuning rules, and reuse of primary role/sampling/evidence semantics must be fixed by Section 11 rather than YAML.
- **REQ-0468 — §11 — Dataset:** Secondary dataset identity must be `CICIoT2023`, acquired from the official Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity release with an exact downloaded-file SHA-256 manifest.
- **REQ-0469 — §11 — Dataset:** The secondary study must use the official pre-extracted labeled CSV representation from the release `CSV` directory; PCAPs must not be re-feature-engineered.
- **REQ-0470 — §11 — Dataset:** Secondary target capability must be `BACKDOOR_MALWARE`; all other observed canonical attack labels plus benign must be supported classes.
- **REQ-0471 — §11 — Dataset:** Official expectations of 33 attacks in seven categories over a 105-device topology and 46 predictor features must be treated as validation expectations rather than substitutes for raw-byte inspection.
- **REQ-0472 — §11 — Dataset:** Observed secondary CSV bytes must determine row/shard counts, file hashes, and ordered predictor schema under the deterministic validation rules.
- **REQ-0474 — §11.1 — Dataset:** Secondary CSV shards must be discovered recursively under the official `CSV` directory and ordered by normalized relative path ascending.
- **REQ-0475 — §11.1 — Dataset:** All secondary shards must resolve to one common header after trimming surrounding ASCII whitespace.
- **REQ-0476 — §11.1 — Dataset:** The label column must be the unique column whose trimmed case-insensitive name is `label`; zero or multiple matches must produce `Data Invalid`.
- **REQ-0477 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** Canonical secondary label tokens must use Unicode NFC, trim, uppercase, maximal non-alphanumeric runs to `_`, repeated-underscore collapse, and leading/trailing underscore removal.
- **REQ-0478 — §11.1 — Dataset:** `BENIGNTRAFFIC` and `BENIGN_TRAFFIC` must both map to `BENIGN`.
- **REQ-0479 — §11.1 — Failure Semantics:** `BACKDOOR_MALWARE` must be observed exactly after canonicalization or the secondary program must be `Data Invalid`.
- **REQ-0480 — §11.1 — Failure Semantics:** Two raw labels may collapse to the same canonical token only when they differ solely by case, whitespace, hyphen, or underscore; any other collision must be `Data Invalid`.
- **REQ-0481 — §11.1 — Dataset:** All non-label columns must initially be candidate predictors.
- **REQ-0482 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** Canonical secondary header tokens must use the same NFC/trim/uppercase/non-alphanumeric normalization as labels.
- **REQ-0483 — §11.1 — Dataset:** A column may be excluded as a row identifier only when its canonical token is one of `INDEX`, `ROW_ID`, `ROWID`, `UNNAMED_0` and it is a no-duplicate per-shard integer sequence equal to zero-based or one-based physical row number.
- **REQ-0484 — §11.1 — Dataset:** Every other non-label secondary column must parse as a numeric predictor.
- **REQ-0485 — §11.1 — Dataset:** Unexpected additional numeric predictors must be retained.
- **REQ-0486 — §11.1 — Dataset:** Missing/documentation-different predictors must not be silently manufactured.
- **REQ-0487 — §11.1 — Dataset:** All secondary shards must resolve to the same ordered predictor names.
- **REQ-0488 — §11.1 — Dataset:** A predictor count other than 46 must be recorded as a documentation discrepancy but may execute when the observed schema is internally consistent and all other validation rules pass.
- **REQ-0489 — §11.1 — Dataset:** The secondary output-class registry must be deterministic: `BENIGN` first, `BACKDOOR_MALWARE` second, then remaining observed canonical labels in lexicographically ascending UTF-8 order.
- **REQ-0490 — §11.1 — Training:** Secondary model input width must derive from the validated predictor count and output width from the canonical class-registry length.
- **REQ-0491 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** All secondary predictors must be parsed to float64 for validation before role construction.
- **REQ-0492 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** Any row containing NaN, ±infinity, or an unparseable numeric value must be excluded by deterministic complete-case deletion.
- **REQ-0493 — §11.1 — Artifact:** Each secondary excluded row must record stable row ID, file identity, original row index, and exclusion reason in `outputs/preprocessing/metadata/dataset_exclusions.parquet`.
- **REQ-0494 — §11.1 — Reporting:** Secondary exclusion counts and rates must be reported.
- **REQ-0495 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** No secondary imputation, finite-value replacement, outcome-based feature dropping, or silent schema repair is allowed.
- **REQ-0496 — §11.1 — Reproducibility:** Secondary `stable_row_id` must be `SHA256(canonical_bytes('CICIOT2023_SAMPLE_ID_V1', normalized_relative_csv_path, file_sha256, zero_based_original_row_index))`.
- **REQ-0497 — §11.1 — Preprocessing:** Duplicate secondary feature rows must be retained as distinct observations because stable identities differ.
- **REQ-0498 — §11.2 — Dataset:** Secondary pseudo-domain count must be derived from the primary proxy count and equal 9.
- **REQ-0499 — §11.2 — Preprocessing:** Each secondary row must be assigned to pseudo-domain `HASH_TO_INDEX('CIC_IOT_2023_PSEUDO_DOMAIN', dataset_manifest_hash, canonical_label, stable_row_id, pseudo_domain_partition_salt, modulus=9)`.
- **REQ-0500 — §11.2 — Reproducibility:** `HASH_TO_INDEX` must use the first 8 SHA-256 bytes of canonical bytes, big-endian unsigned, modulo the supplied modulus.
- **REQ-0501 — §11.2 — Configuration:** The pseudo-domain partition salt must come from `datasets.secondary.pseudo_domain_partition_salt`.
- **REQ-0503 — §11.3 — Preprocessing:** Within each canonical `label × pseudo_domain` group, retained rows must be ordered by `stable_row_id` byte value ascending.
- **REQ-0504 — §11.3 — Preprocessing:** Secondary role assignment must reuse the primary supported/target normalized role intervals using group-local index/count.
- **REQ-0505 — §11.3 — Preprocessing:** Physical CSV shard order must not otherwise affect secondary role membership.
- **REQ-0506 — §11.3 — Algorithm:** Secondary execution must reuse the same sampling caps, evidence minima, Capability Claim Contract numerical thresholds, optimizer/training parameters, model family, seed/hash logic, verifier semantics, and applicable synthesis procedure without retuning.
- **REQ-0507 — §11.3 — Preprocessing:** CICIoT2023 must fit its own scaler from supported-class `Anchor Train` rows across its nine pseudo-domains using the Section 10.5 formula and clipping rule.
- **REQ-0508 — §11.3 — Preprocessing:** The N-BaIoT scaler must never be applied to CICIoT2023.
- **REQ-0509 — §11.3 — Failure Semantics:** If real secondary data cannot satisfy required target-holder/evidence minima, the affected cell must become `Evidence Insufficient`/`Dormant` under protocol semantics.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0137 — §5.3:** Only secondary dataset schema, class vocabulary, and target label may differ as explicitly specified.
- **REQ-0510 — §11.3:** Secondary target label, thresholds, pseudo-domain count, and role intervals must never be changed to rescue feasibility.
- **REQ-0511 — §11.3:** No primary threshold may be retuned from secondary outcomes.
- **REQ-2047 — §40:** Primary N-BaIoT is used because nine device identities support heterogeneous device-proxy federation and a Gafgyt subtype can be withheld; devices are proxies, not organizational independence.
- **REQ-2048 — §40:** Secondary CICIoT2023 supports distinct IoT attack-corpus mechanism-direction testing; deterministic pseudo-domains support only data/attack generalization.

# M02 — I12 Implement Preprocess CLI and Provenance-Aware Dataset Materialization

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M02 — Validated Dataset and Evidence-Role Preparation
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement `fedsira preprocess` selection, materialization, overwrite/reuse, failure/status behavior, and production of validated dataset artifacts for both datasets.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §24.2

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1530–REQ-1536
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement `fedsira preprocess` selection, materialization, overwrite/reuse, failure/status behavior, and production of validated dataset artifacts for both datasets.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1530 — §24.2 — CLI / Execution:** `preprocess <dataset>` must preprocess exactly the named roadmap dataset; without a dataset it must preprocess all roadmap datasets requiring preprocessing.
- **REQ-1531 — §24.2 — CLI / Execution:** `preprocess` must perform Sections 9–11 identity/schema validation, canonicalization, archive/shard discovery, role/split construction, scaling, caps, feasibility, leakage checks, and dataset/domain manifests.
- **REQ-1532 — §24.2 — CLI / Execution:** `preprocess` must never modify raw source files.
- **REQ-1533 — §24.2 — Artifact:** Each valid prepared-data artifact, split/role manifest, scaler, and deterministic prepared view must be independently reusable when its own dependency fingerprint matches.
- **REQ-1534 — §24.2 — Artifact:** Reprocessing a dataset must not force retraining when resulting upstream artifact identities are unchanged.
- **REQ-1535 — §24.2 — CLI / Execution:** `preprocess --overwrite` must rematerialize preprocessing-owned artifacts under the unchanged contract with atomic publication.
- **REQ-1536 — §24.2 — Artifact:** If overwrite produces unchanged logical/scientific identity, descendants must remain valid; if parent identity changes, only descendants become stale.

- None assigned to this issue.

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M02 — Validated Dataset and Evidence-Role Preparation
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the complete §28.1 dataset validation suite and the blocking `Data and Domain Evidence Validation` experiment/gate.
- **Issue type:** Validation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §28.1
- §30.1
- §32

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1694–REQ-1705; REQ-1783–REQ-1786
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-1941

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the complete §28.1 dataset validation suite and the blocking `Data and Domain Evidence Validation` experiment/gate.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1694 — §28.1 — Testing:** Capture exact raw-file checksums.
- **REQ-1695 — §28.1 — Testing:** Regenerate deterministic roles identically.
- **REQ-1696 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove no cross-role sample overlap.
- **REQ-1697 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove no target sample enters anchor roles.
- **REQ-1698 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove scaler fitting uses only supported Anchor Train rows.
- **REQ-1699 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove guard-gap rows never appear downstream.
- **REQ-1700 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove source/reproducer/verifier/final/report roles are disjoint.
- **REQ-1701 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove structural missing classes are recorded rather than fabricated.
- **REQ-1702 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove repeated preprocessing yields identical content hashes.
- **REQ-1703 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove primary sample IDs and preprocessing sample-order seed match Section 10 canonical-hash fixtures.
- **REQ-1704 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove archive and already-extracted N-BaIoT layouts yield identical canonical identities when extracted CSV bytes are identical.
- **REQ-1705 — §28.1 — Testing:** Prove CICIoT2023 label normalization, identifier exclusion, stable-row order, pseudo-domain assignment, and group-local role intervals match hand fixtures.

# M03 — I14 Implement Fixed Model Architecture and Training Primitives

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M03 — Deterministic Model Training and Evaluation Core
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the exact classifier architecture, initialization, loss, AdamW, batching, precision, clipping, optimizer lifecycle, parameter representation, and prohibition on implicit consequential defaults.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §12
- §12.1
- §12.2

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0512–REQ-0533; REQ-0535–REQ-0558; REQ-2094–REQ-2098
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0534

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the exact classifier architecture, initialization, loss, AdamW, batching, precision, clipping, optimizer lifecycle, parameter representation, and prohibition on implicit consequential defaults.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0512 — §12 — Configuration:** YAML `model.*` may contain only the numerical optimizer hyperparameters, batch size/gradient clip, anchor counts/cadences, post-reference weights/budget, and verifier-aware numerical override.
- **REQ-0513 — §12 — Configuration:** Architecture, initialization, loss/reduction semantics, checkpoint selection, data-role access, participation/aggregation behavior, precision, and fixed execution semantics must be implemented from Section 12, not configurable strings/booleans.
- **REQ-0514 — §12 — Configuration:** Model input/output widths and trainable-parameter count must remain derived facts rather than duplicated configuration.
- **REQ-0515 — §12.1 — Training:** The model family must be a fully connected multiclass MLP with dataset-derived `D_in` and `D_out`.
- **REQ-0516 — §12.1 — Training:** The base model input layer width must be dataset-derived `D_in`.
- **REQ-0517 — §12.1 — Training:** MLP hidden layer 1 must be `Linear(D_in,256)`.
- **REQ-0518 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 1 normalization must be `LayerNorm(256, eps=1e-5, elementwise_affine=True, bias=True)`.
- **REQ-0519 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 1 activation must be `GELU(approximate="none")`.
- **REQ-0520 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 1 dropout must be `Dropout(p=0.10)`.
- **REQ-0521 — §12.1 — Training:** MLP hidden layer 2 must be `Linear(256,128)`.
- **REQ-0522 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 2 normalization must be `LayerNorm(128, eps=1e-5, elementwise_affine=True, bias=True)`.
- **REQ-0523 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 2 activation must be `GELU(approximate="none")`.
- **REQ-0524 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 2 dropout must be `Dropout(p=0.10)`.
- **REQ-0525 — §12.1 — Training:** MLP hidden layer 3 must be `Linear(128,64)`.
- **REQ-0526 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 3 normalization must be `LayerNorm(64, eps=1e-5, elementwise_affine=True, bias=True)`.
- **REQ-0527 — §12.1 — Training:** Hidden layer 3 activation must be `GELU(approximate="none")`.
- **REQ-0528 — §12.1 — Training:** MLP output layer must be `Linear(64,D_out)` with dataset-derived `D_out`.
- **REQ-0529 — §12.1 — Training:** The MLP modules must appear in the exact order specified in Section 12.1, with no additional hidden layer, activation, normalization, or dropout stage.
- **REQ-0530 — §12.1 — Training:** Expected primary widths are `D_in=115`, `D_out=11`, but execution must use validated derived dimensions and fail primary data validation if incompatible with the fixed class contract.
- **REQ-0531 — §12.1 — Training:** All linear weights must use Xavier uniform initialization with gain 1.0.
- **REQ-0532 — §12.1 — Training:** All linear biases must initialize to 0.0.
- **REQ-0533 — §12.1 — Training:** Every LayerNorm scale parameter must initialize to `1.0`.
- **REQ-2094 — §12.1 — Training:** Every LayerNorm bias parameter must initialize to `0.0`.
- **REQ-0535 — §12.2 — Training:** Cross-entropy class weights must be none.
- **REQ-0536 — §12.2 — Training:** Cross-entropy reduction must be arithmetic mean over the minibatch.
- **REQ-0537 — §12.2 — Training:** Cross-entropy label smoothing must be 0.0.
- **REQ-0538 — §12.2 — Training:** The scientific label path must not use `ignore_index`.
- **REQ-0539 — §12.2 — Configuration:** Anchor/standard-FL AdamW learning rate must be `1e-3`.
- **REQ-0540 — §12.2 — Configuration:** AdamW betas must be `(0.9,0.999)`.
- **REQ-0541 — §12.2 — Configuration:** AdamW epsilon must be `1e-8`.
- **REQ-0542 — §12.2 — Configuration:** AdamW weight decay must be `1e-4`.
- **REQ-0543 — §12.2 — Training:** AdamW must use `amsgrad=False`.
- **REQ-2095 — §12.2 — Training:** AdamW must use `maximize=False`.
- **REQ-2096 — §12.2 — Training:** AdamW must use `capturable=False`.
- **REQ-2097 — §12.2 — Training:** AdamW must use `differentiable=False`.
- **REQ-0544 — §12.2 — Training:** Reference AdamW execution must use `foreach=False`.
- **REQ-2098 — §12.2 — Training:** Reference AdamW execution must use `fused=False`.
- **REQ-0545 — §12.2 — Configuration:** Scientific batch size must be 256.
- **REQ-0546 — §12.2 — Training:** Final partial minibatches must be retained (`drop_last=False`).
- **REQ-0547 — §12.2 — Training:** Every local/central training invocation must construct a fresh AdamW optimizer at invocation start.
- **REQ-0548 — §12.2 — Training:** Optimizer state must persist across epochs within one invocation and be checkpointed for recovery.
- **REQ-0549 — §12.2 — Training:** AdamW moment state must not carry from one FedAvg communication round to the next.
- **REQ-0550 — §12.2 — Training:** Each new FedAvg round client must start from the received global model with a fresh optimizer.
- **REQ-0551 — §12.2 — Configuration:** Global gradient L2 clipping must be 5.0.
- **REQ-0552 — §12.2 — Training:** Batch order must use Section 13 deterministic hash ordering, not an implicit data-loader RNG shuffle.
- **REQ-0553 — §12.2 — Training:** Mixed precision must be disabled for claim-bearing runs.
- **REQ-0554 — §12.2 — Training:** Model computation must use float32.
- **REQ-0555 — §12.2 — Evaluation:** Metric/statistical aggregation must use float64.
- **REQ-0556 — §12.2 — Training:** Early stopping must be disabled.
- **REQ-0557 — §12.2 — Training:** Checkpoint selection must use the final configured round/epoch, never best observed validation performance.
- **REQ-0558 — §12.2 — Training:** Optimizer gradients must be cleared with `set_to_none=True`.

# M03 — I15 Implement Anchor, Source, and Independent Reproduction Training

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M03 — Deterministic Model Training and Evaluation Core
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement deterministic anchor FedAvg, post-reference source candidate training, honest reproduction from anchor/non-source evidence, fixed budgets/objectives, malicious-training override boundary, and no test-role tuning.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §12.3
- §12.4
- §12.5
- §12.6

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0559–REQ-0590; REQ-2099
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement deterministic anchor FedAvg, post-reference source candidate training, honest reproduction from anchor/non-source evidence, fixed budgets/objectives, malicious-training override boundary, and no test-role tuning.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0559 — §12.3 — Training:** Anchor model initialization must use the `Model Initialization` namespace.
- **REQ-0560 — §12.3 — Configuration:** Anchor FedAvg must run exactly 20 rounds.
- **REQ-0561 — §12.3 — Training:** Every available one of the nine primary domains must participate each anchor round.
- **REQ-0562 — §12.3 — Configuration:** Each anchor client must train exactly 1 local epoch per round.
- **REQ-0563 — §12.3 — Configuration:** Anchor client dropout must be 0.
- **REQ-0564 — §12.3 — Training:** FedAvg client weight must equal the number of scientific training examples actually processed in that round.
- **REQ-0565 — §12.3 — Training:** Anchor aggregation must be sample-count-weighted FedAvg.
- **REQ-0566 — §12.3 — Artifact:** Anchor checkpoints must be written every round.
- **REQ-0567 — §12.3 — Evaluation:** Anchor evaluation must run every round on `Anchor Validation` and remain descriptive only.
- **REQ-0568 — §12.3 — Training:** The authoritative anchor must be the final configured round checkpoint.
- **REQ-0569 — §12.3 — Training:** The target class must be completely absent from anchor training and validation.
- **REQ-0570 — §12.4 — Configuration:** The common post-reference budget must be read only from `model.post_reference.local_epochs`, `model.optimizer.post_reference_learning_rate`, and `model.training.batch_size` unless a named contract explicitly overrides it.
- **REQ-0571 — §12.4 — Training:** The source candidate must start from the fixed anchor.
- **REQ-0572 — §12.4 — Training:** Source candidate training data must be source `Source Proposal` target rows plus source `Post-Reference Replay` supported rows.
- **REQ-0573 — §12.4 — Training:** Honest reproduction must start from the same fixed anchor.
- **REQ-0574 — §12.4 — Training:** Honest reproduction training data must be that domain's `Reproduction` target rows plus `Post-Reference Replay` supported rows.
- **REQ-0575 — §12.4 — Training:** Source and honest reproduction must use the Section 7.3 empirical objective.
- **REQ-0576 — §12.4 — Training:** Each post-reference epoch must use one combined target+supported sequence ordered independently by Section 13.3, with no stratification, oversampling, or duplication merely to form batches.
- **REQ-0577 — §12.4 — Training:** Minibatch CE must be the arithmetic mean across all examples so target/supported contributions follow selected population proportions.
- **REQ-0578 — §12.4 — Training:** The stability KL term must be computed only on supported replay examples present in the same minibatch.
- **REQ-0579 — §12.4 — Training:** Per supported example, stability must compute `KL(anchor_softmax \|\| current_softmax)` at temperature 1.0, sum across classes, then mean across supported examples.
- **REQ-0580 — §12.4 — Training:** A minibatch with zero supported examples must use `D_stable=0.0` and must not synthesize/repeat a supported row.
- **REQ-0581 — §12.4 — Training:** The delta-L2 term must be evaluated on the full current trainable-parameter vector at every optimizer step.
- **REQ-0582 — §12.4 — Configuration:** Post-reference stability weight must be 1.0 and delta-L2 weight `1e-5`.
- **REQ-0583 — §12.4 — Training:** Delta-L2 normalization divisor must be the derived trainable-parameter count.
- **REQ-0584 — §12.4 — Training:** Canonical parameter-vector order must be `model.named_parameters()` registration order; tensors must be flattened contiguous row-major and concatenated.
- **REQ-0585 — §12.4 — Training:** The same canonical parameter order must be used for deltas, Krum distances, cosine similarity, clipping, and hashes.
- **REQ-0586 — §12.4 — Training:** The source artifact must never be passed to the honest-reproduction code path.
- **REQ-0587 — §12.5 — Training:** Only the named `Verifier-Aware Backdoor` attack may override the common post-reference epoch count to 10.
- **REQ-0588 — §12.5 — Training:** `Verifier-Aware Backdoor` must add triggered-backdoor loss weight `2.0`.
- **REQ-2099 — §12.5 — Training:** All optimizer parameters not explicitly overridden by `Verifier-Aware Backdoor` must reuse the common post-reference configuration.
- **REQ-0589 — §12.6 — Training:** `Row Verification`, `Final Gate`, and `Report Test` roles must be inaccessible to optimizer/model-selection functions by API design.
- **REQ-0590 — §12.6 — Testing:** Training-loader requests for `Row Verification`, `Final Gate`, or `Report Test` must raise an invariant error in tests.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

- None assigned to this issue.

# M03 — I16 Implement Core Classification, Capability, Security, and Admission Metrics

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M03 — Deterministic Model Training and Evaluation Core
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement confusion-derived classification metrics, target/support/benign contract metrics, equal-domain aggregation, admission/certification rates, backdoor/security metrics, and canonical delay components.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §3
- §17.1
- §17
- §17.2
- §17.3
- §17.4
- §17.10

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0077; REQ-0834–REQ-0873; REQ-0924–REQ-0930; REQ-2090–REQ-2093
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement confusion-derived classification metrics, target/support/benign contract metrics, equal-domain aggregation, admission/certification rates, backdoor/security metrics, and canonical delay components.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0077 — §3 — Metric:** `T_evidence` must denote the information-arrival component of admission delay.
- **REQ-2090 — §3 — Metric:** `T_assignment` must denote role-assignment latency after required evidence exists.
- **REQ-2091 — §3 — Metric:** `T_reproduce` must denote reproduction-training latency.
- **REQ-2092 — §3 — Metric:** `T_verify` must denote external-verification latency.
- **REQ-2093 — §3 — Metric:** `T_synthesize` must denote Krum synthesis plus final-gate latency.
- **REQ-0834 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Accuracy` must be defined exactly as: `sum_c TP_c / N`; range [0,1], higher better.
- **REQ-0835 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Precision_c` must be defined exactly as: `TP_c/(TP_c+FP_c)`; zero denominator => `NA`.
- **REQ-0836 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Recall_c/TPR_c` must be defined exactly as: `TP_c/(TP_c+FN_c)`; zero denominator => `NA`.
- **REQ-0837 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `FPR_c` must be defined exactly as: `FP_c/(FP_c+TN_c)`.
- **REQ-0838 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `FNR_c` must be defined exactly as: `FN_c/(FN_c+TP_c)`.
- **REQ-0839 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `TNR_c` must be defined exactly as: `TN_c/(TN_c+FP_c)=1-FPR_c`.
- **REQ-0840 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `F1_c` must be defined exactly as: `2TP_c/(2TP_c+FP_c+FN_c)`; zero denominator => `NA`.
- **REQ-0841 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Balanced Accuracy` must be defined exactly as: Unweighted mean of `Recall_c` over valid classes.
- **REQ-0842 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Macro-F1` must be defined exactly as: Unweighted mean of `F1_c` over valid classes; undefined F1 classes excluded and valid-class count reported; never support-weighted.
- **REQ-0843 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Weighted F1` must be defined exactly as: Support-weighted mean of valid class F1 values.
- **REQ-0844 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `Target F1` must be defined exactly as: Primary `F1_GAFGYT_COMBO`; secondary `F1_BACKDOOR_MALWARE`.
- **REQ-0845 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `AUROC` must be defined exactly as: One-vs-rest ROC AUC from unrounded class softmax probability; macro AUROC is equal-class mean over classes with positives and negatives.
- **REQ-0846 — §17.1 — Metric:** Metric `AUPRC` must be defined exactly as: One-vs-rest PR area by trapezoidal integration over recall-sorted operating points; macro AUPRC is equal-class mean over defined classes; descriptive only.
- **REQ-0847 — §17 — Metric:** All metric functions must live in one registry and return both metric value and denominator metadata.
- **REQ-0848 — §17 — Metric:** Stored metrics must use float64 and must never be rounded before comparisons.
- **REQ-0849 — §17.2 — Metric:** Target capability gain must be `TargetF1(w)-TargetF1(w_a)` and higher is better.
- **REQ-0850 — §17.2 — Metric:** Supported macro-F1 harm must be `MacroF1_supported(w_a)-MacroF1_supported(w)`; lower is better and negative values indicate improvement.
- **REQ-0851 — §17.2 — Metric:** The supported-harm Capability Claim Contract threshold must be `<=0.02`.
- **REQ-0852 — §17.2 — Metric:** Benign FAR must be the fraction of true benign examples predicted as any non-benign class; it must not be replaced by one-vs-rest `FPR_BENIGN`.
- **REQ-0853 — §17.2 — Metric:** Benign FAR increase must be `BenignFAR(w)-BenignFAR(w_a)`; lower is better and contract threshold is `<=0.01`.
- **REQ-0854 — §17.3 — Metric:** ASR must be measured on triggered `GAFGYT_UDP` examples with ground truth retained and equal-weight defined non-source domain ASRs at seed level; scenarios without a trigger/carrier report `NA`.
- **REQ-0855 — §17.3 — Metric:** `malicious_admission` must be a per-seed binary provenance/security outcome, distinct from ordinary admission, and is defined only when the scenario contains a predeclared compromised source, reproducer, verifier-assisted malicious row, or ordinary-FL client update.
- **REQ-0856 — §17.3 — Metric:** Direct/clipped source deployment or any source-derived production update from a compromised source must count as compromised production ancestry.
- **REQ-0857 — §17.3 — Metric:** Single-reproduction production is compromised iff the selected row is compromised; Krum production iff the selected Krum row is compromised.
- **REQ-0858 — §17.3 — Metric:** FedAvg/ensemble/filtering/clustering production is compromised iff at least one accepted compromised post-reference update has nonzero final ancestry.
- **REQ-0859 — §17.3 — Metric:** Rollback to clean anchor followed solely by source-excluded honest recovery must remove discarded compromised ancestry for MAR accounting.
- **REQ-0860 — §17.3 — Metric:** Compromised verifier behavior alone must not create malicious admission unless it enables a compromised production object to be admitted.
- **REQ-0861 — §17.3 — Metric:** MAR must be the mean `malicious_admission` over eligible malicious-authority seed instances; cells without such a fixture must report `NA`, not zero.
- **REQ-0862 — §17.3 — Metric:** `legitimate_admission` is defined for scenarios containing the real target capability and equals 1 iff terminal outcome is `Admitted`, otherwise 0 for `Dormant`, `Rejected Claim`, or `Expired`.
- **REQ-0863 — §17.3 — Metric:** Generic-hard-supported and irrelevant-source-improvement episodes must report legitimate admission as `NA`.
- **REQ-0864 — §17.3 — Metric:** LAR must be the mean legitimate-admission indicator over eligible target-capability seed instances.
- **REQ-0865 — §17.3 — Metric:** A scenario may have both LAR and MAR defined; LAR measures availability and MAR compromised authority reaching production.
- **REQ-0866 — §17.3 — Metric:** Verifier abstention rate must equal abstaining verifier reports / assigned verifier reports.
- **REQ-0867 — §17.3 — Metric:** Reproduction abstention rate must equal evidence-insufficient opportunities / assigned reproduction opportunities.
- **REQ-0868 — §17.3 — Metric:** Dormant claim rate must equal claims ending `Dormant` at evaluation horizon / eligible claims.
- **REQ-0869 — §17.4 — Metric:** Worst-domain target F1 must be the minimum defined target F1 across adequate honest domains.
- **REQ-0870 — §17.4 — Metric:** P10 domain target F1 must use type-7/linear 0.10 quantile across adequate domains.
- **REQ-0871 — §17.4 — Metric:** Domain disparity must equal maximum minus minimum target F1.
- **REQ-0872 — §17.4 — Metric:** IQR must equal type-7 `Q0.75-Q0.25`.
- **REQ-0873 — §17.4 — Metric:** Coefficient of variation must be sample SD (`ddof=1`) divided by positive mean; zero mean => `NA`.
- **REQ-0924 — §17.10 — Evaluation:** Shared-epistemic clean-oracle degradation reference must be the matched uncorrupted `Resolved FedSIRA Core × Legitimate Unsupported Capability × same master_seed` object with matching dataset/source/anchor/roles/assignments/core/training semantics.
- **REQ-0925 — §17.10 — Artifact:** If the matched uncorrupted reference is not already materialized, the boundary execution may materialize it as a shared prerequisite artifact without creating a new experiment cell.
- **REQ-0926 — §17.10 — Metric:** Clean-oracle target-F1 delta, supported-macro-F1 delta, and benign-FAR delta must be reported separately and must not be collapsed into an undocumented scalar.
- **REQ-0927 — §17.10 — Metric:** False-same-capability numerator and denominator must both be persisted; zero broad-certified rows => `NA`; scoped contracts => `NA` with reason `No Cross-Root-Cause Equivalence Assertion`.
- **REQ-0928 — §17.10 — Statistical Analysis:** Descriptive 95% CIs around a single method seed-level mean must use the same 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap and analysis seed as Section 18.5 but resample method seed values rather than paired differences.
- **REQ-0929 — §17.10 — Reporting:** Raw method result tables must report sample SD across defined seed values.
- **REQ-0930 — §17.10 — Evaluation:** Generic 80% aggregation sufficiency must apply only when no stronger protocol-specific threshold exists; final gate/verifier/reproducer gates must keep their own thresholds.

# M03 — I17 Implement Screening, Distribution, Delay, Efficiency, and Missing-Metric Semantics

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M03 — Deterministic Model Training and Evaluation Core
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement candidate-screen, cross-domain distribution, delay/resource/communication metrics, evaluation populations, matched-clean references, NA/undefined handling, false-equivalence diagnostics, and descriptive uncertainty inputs.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §17.5
- §17.6
- §17.7
- §17.8
- §17.9

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0874–REQ-0880; REQ-0882–REQ-0923
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0881

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement candidate-screen, cross-domain distribution, delay/resource/communication metrics, evaluation populations, matched-clean references, NA/undefined handling, false-equivalence diagnostics, and descriptive uncertainty inputs.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0874 — §17.5 — Metric:** The clean proposal oracle must evaluate the committed source candidate post-execution on clean non-source `Report Test` roles and must never be available to opening/training.
- **REQ-0875 — §17.5 — Metric:** A proposal oracle is valid only if aggregate target F1≥0.80, target gain≥0.20, supported macro-F1 drop≤0.02, benign-FAR increase≤0.01, and at least 80% of eight expected non-source domains have required metrics; otherwise oracle label is `NA`.
- **REQ-0876 — §17.5 — Metric:** False launch rate must count proposal-assisted instances that launch at least one downstream scientific reproduction attempt while the clean proposal oracle is invalid, divided by instances with adequate screen decision and defined oracle.
- **REQ-0877 — §17.5 — Metric:** Reproduction attempts must count distinct domains where scientific reproduction training actually starts; evidence-inadequate inspections must not count as attempts.
- **REQ-0878 — §17.5 — Metric:** Proposal-screen differential `A` must use the Section 7.2 definition.
- **REQ-0879 — §17.6 — Metric:** Delay must be represented in logical evidence cycles and real wall-clock seconds as separate units.
- **REQ-0880 — §17.6 — Metric:** The delay decomposition record must be the ordered pair `T_evidence` cycles and `T_assignment+T_reproduce+T_verify+T_synthesize` seconds; logical cycles must never be numerically added to seconds.
- **REQ-0882 — §17.6 — Metric:** `T_assignment` must measure pure assignment/selection intervals on the sequential critical path and exclude model training, scoring, and final-gate evaluation.
- **REQ-0883 — §17.6 — Metric:** `T_reproduce` must sum elapsed required reproduction/local-update training through committed-update publication.
- **REQ-0884 — §17.6 — Metric:** `T_verify` must sum post-commitment verifier assignment through report publication intervals and be 0 when external verification is omitted.
- **REQ-0885 — §17.6 — Metric:** `T_synthesize` must measure from production-row completion through production-update construction and final-gate completion; Krum only when plurality is active.
- **REQ-0886 — §17.6 — Metric:** Post-evidence overhead must equal `T_assignment+T_reproduce+T_verify+T_synthesize`.
- **REQ-0887 — §17.7 — Metric:** Reproducer GPU time must sum CUDA-event elapsed seconds across included reproduction/local-update jobs.
- **REQ-0888 — §17.7 — Metric:** Verifier GPU/CPU time must measure elapsed verifier compute seconds.
- **REQ-0889 — §17.7 — Metric:** Server synthesis time must include production-update construction plus final-gate evaluator time.
- **REQ-0890 — §17.7 — Metric:** Wall-clock runtime must measure from first post-reference method action after prepared data/anchor load to terminal artifact publication, excluding preprocessing and anchor construction.
- **REQ-0891 — §17.7 — Metric:** Peak GPU memory must be maximum allocated CUDA bytes per process.
- **REQ-0892 — §17.7 — Metric:** Peak host RSS must be maximum resident-set bytes during execution.
- **REQ-0893 — §17.7 — Metric:** Persistent storage bytes must count persistent artifacts newly generated under `outputs/`, excluding shared pre-existing inputs.
- **REQ-0894 — §17.7 — Metric:** Communication accounting must be conceptual client/server protocol serialization independent of OS-process topology.
- **REQ-0895 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Counted communication metadata fields must be exactly `schema,message_type,dataset_manifest_hash,semantic_cell_key_hash,master_seed,round_index,sender,receiver,claim_contract_hash,payload_tensor_count`.
- **REQ-0896 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Communication schema must be literal `FEDSIRA_COMM_V1`; inapplicable scalars must be JSON null; domain IDs use fixed tokens and server uses `SERVER`.
- **REQ-0897 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Allowed message types must be exactly SOURCE_COMMITMENT, MODEL_DISTRIBUTION, UPDATE_SUBMISSION, CLAIM_CONTRACT, REVIEW_ASSIGNMENT, REVIEW_REPORT, VERIFIER_ASSIGNMENT, VERIFIER_REPORT, FINAL_GATE_ASSIGNMENT, FINAL_GATE_REPORT, DECISION.
- **REQ-0898 — §17.7 — Artifact:** A model tensor carried with an assignment must be part of that assignment message, not duplicated as a second metadata message.
- **REQ-0899 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Communication metadata must use canonical JSON sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, decimal integers, shortest-round-trip finite floats, and canonical strings, prefixed by unsigned 64-bit big-endian metadata length.
- **REQ-0900 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Each tensor payload must be contiguous little-endian scientific dtype, prefixed by canonical JSON tensor metadata (`name,dtype,shape,nbytes`) and unsigned 64-bit big-endian metadata length.
- **REQ-0901 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Tensor fields must be concatenated in lexicographically ascending tensor-name order without compression.
- **REQ-0902 — §17.7 — Metric:** Every semantic cross-boundary action used by the method must be counted; a broadcast to `k` domains counts as `k` messages.
- **REQ-0903 — §17.7 — Artifact:** Model tensors must be named `model.<canonical_parameter_name>` and updates `update.<canonical_parameter_name>`.
- **REQ-0904 — §17.7 — Metric:** Local filesystem writes must be excluded from communication accounting.
- **REQ-0905 — §17.7 — Metric:** Communication bytes must sum envelope bytes in both directions; model transmissions count only messages containing model/checkpoint/update tensor payloads.
- **REQ-0906 — §17.7 — Reproducibility:** Peak GPU memory must use `torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()` after reset.
- **REQ-0907 — §17.7 — Reproducibility:** Peak host RSS must use `resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss ×1024` on Ubuntu/Linux in a dedicated single-process timing worker.
- **REQ-0908 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Primary claim-bearing production report aggregation must use the eight non-source domains for that seed; source report-test rows are excluded from method-comparison seed aggregates.
- **REQ-0909 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Secondary production report aggregation must analogously use eight non-source pseudo-domains.
- **REQ-0910 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Class metrics must be computed within each expected non-source domain before adequacy filtering and equal-domain aggregation.
- **REQ-0911 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Seed-level metric aggregation must equal-weight defined domain values and seed-level values must be the independent inference units.
- **REQ-0912 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Worst/P10/disparity/heterogeneity metrics must use only adequate honest non-source domains; compromised domains are excluded from those honest-domain summaries.
- **REQ-0913 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Compromised domains may remain in ordinary clean-oracle summaries unless a metric explicitly excludes them.
- **REQ-0914 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Final-gate decisions must use the stronger Section 7.7 adequacy rule, not generic report-test aggregation.
- **REQ-0915 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** Offline Report Test evaluation must be performed by the experimental evaluator from immutable role data.
- **REQ-0916 — §17.8 — Evaluation:** A Byzantine role designation must not permit falsifying report-test labels or final-gate scores unless an explicit Section 15 evidence-oracle corruption applies.
- **REQ-0917 — §17.8 — Statistical Analysis:** Client/domain rows are repeated measures and must never be treated as independent inferential replicates.
- **REQ-0918 — §17.9 — Metric:** Any metric zero denominator must produce `NA`, never 0.
- **REQ-0919 — §17.9 — Evaluation:** Ordinary report-test equal-domain aggregation over eight expected domains requires at least 7 defined domains under the generic 80% rule.
- **REQ-0920 — §17.9 — Evaluation:** A seed-level equal-domain aggregate is valid only when the required expected-domain count is defined unless scientific outcome is explicitly evidence insufficiency.
- **REQ-0921 — §17.9 — Metric:** Scientific `Dormant`/`Abstain` outcomes must be analyzed as outcomes rather than missing values.
- **REQ-0922 — §17.9 — Statistical Analysis:** Structurally `NA` comparisons by design are not comparison-family members.
- **REQ-0923 — §17.9 — Statistical Analysis:** Comparison-family members undefined through scientific/technical missingness must follow Section 18.8 and cannot support a claim.

# M03 — I18 Validate Model, FL, Metric, and Statistical Numerics

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M03 — Deterministic Model Training and Evaluation Core
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement deterministic model/training numerical tests and hand-calculated metric/statistical validation required by §§28.2 and 28.5.
- **Issue type:** Validation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §28.2
- §28.5

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1706–REQ-1714; REQ-1736–REQ-1743
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement deterministic model/training numerical tests and hand-calculated metric/statistical validation required by §§28.2 and 28.5.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1706 — §28.2 — Testing:** One-batch model forward/backward must remain finite.
- **REQ-1707 — §28.2 — Testing:** One-round FedAvg must match a hand-computed weighted-average fixture.
- **REQ-1708 — §28.2 — Testing:** Checkpoint restore must reproduce predictions within 1e-6 absolute tolerance.
- **REQ-1709 — §28.2 — Testing:** Data-loader seed must affect only intended shuffling.
- **REQ-1710 — §28.2 — Testing:** Final-round checkpoint selection must be enforced.
- **REQ-1711 — §28.2 — Testing:** Training code must be unable to request Report Test loader.
- **REQ-1712 — §28.2 — Testing:** AdamW state must persist across epochs within one invocation and reset between FedAvg rounds.
- **REQ-1713 — §28.2 — Testing:** Isolated child-seed derivation must make identical training jobs bitwise-identical regardless of scheduling.
- **REQ-1714 — §28.2 — Testing:** A post-reference minibatch without supported rows must zero only KL while computing CE/L2 exactly.
- **REQ-1736 — §28.5 — Testing:** Confusion-derived metrics must match hand calculations.
- **REQ-1737 — §28.5 — Testing:** Zero denominators must return `NA` plus reason.
- **REQ-1738 — §28.5 — Testing:** Type-7 quantiles must match NumPy `method='linear'` fixtures.
- **REQ-1739 — §28.5 — Testing:** Sample SD must use `ddof=1`.
- **REQ-1740 — §28.5 — Testing:** Exact sign-flip test must enumerate exactly 1024 assignments at n=10.
- **REQ-1741 — §28.5 — Testing:** Holm adjustment must match an independent hand fixture.
- **REQ-1742 — §28.5 — Testing:** 10,000 bootstrap draws must be deterministic under seed 424242.
- **REQ-1743 — §28.5 — Testing:** Client rows must never become independent inferential observations.

# M04 — I19 Implement Capability Claim Contract and FedSIRA State Machine

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the immutable Capability Claim Contract, evidence sufficiency, claim identity, state vocabulary/transitions, resource horizon, attempt consumption, dormancy/resume/expiry, and non-negotiable authority-path invariants.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- Roadmap preamble
- §1.1
- §1.2
- §1.3
- §5
- §5.1
- §5.2
- §5.3
- §6.1
- §6.2
- §6.3
- §6.4

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0007–REQ-0017; REQ-0118–REQ-0136; REQ-0139–REQ-0153; REQ-0155–REQ-0195
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0003–REQ-0005; REQ-0154; REQ-2081–REQ-2085

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the immutable Capability Claim Contract, evidence sufficiency, claim identity, state vocabulary/transitions, resource horizon, attempt consumption, dormancy/resume/expiry, and non-negotiable authority-path invariants.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0007 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** A clean/current anchor checkpoint must exist for every claim instance.
- **REQ-0008 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** The Capability Claim Contract must be immutable before reproduction outcomes are observed.
- **REQ-0009 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** The source artifact must have zero direct production weight.
- **REQ-0010 — §1.3 — Training:** Honest reproduction must start from the anchor and use non-source local evidence only.
- **REQ-0011 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** Every reproduction must be committed before verifier assignment.
- **REQ-0012 — §1.3 — Evaluation:** Verifier evidence must be fresh relative to the reproduction being verified.
- **REQ-0013 — §1.3 — Robustness:** Every claim instance must use a declared Byzantine evidence profile.
- **REQ-0014 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** The number of certified non-source reproduction rows must satisfy the selected synthesis rule's own admissibility condition.
- **REQ-0015 — §1.3 — Algorithm:** Robust synthesis must have no explicit source-artifact input.
- **REQ-0016 — §1.3 — Evaluation:** A final fresh gate must run after production-update construction/synthesis.
- **REQ-0017 — §1.3 — Failure Semantics:** The protocol must expose explicit `Dormant`, `Rejected Claim`, and `Expired` outcomes rather than forcing acceptance.
- **REQ-0118 — §5 — Configuration:** Numerical Capability Claim Contract thresholds/evidence minima must be supplied by `capability_claim.*`; numerical opening/verification/synthesis/final-gate/resource limits must be supplied by the applicable `protocol.*` fields.
- **REQ-0119 — §5 — Configuration:** Capability Claim Contract metric definitions, eligibility semantics, ordering rules, and failure behavior must be implemented from Sections 5–7 rather than configurable strings.
- **REQ-0120 — §5 — Mathematics:** Every claim instance must be represented as `𝒞=(𝒮,𝓜,𝓚,Γ,B,Ω)`.
- **REQ-0121 — §5 — Algorithm:** `𝒮` must select local post-reference `GAFGYT_COMBO` examples plus designated supported-control replay rows, with membership determined only by immutable split manifest, domain, label, and role.
- **REQ-0122 — §5 — Metric:** `𝓜` must be `GAFGYT_COMBO` one-vs-rest F1 on the designated fresh evaluation population.
- **REQ-0123 — §5 — Metric:** `𝓚` must comprise supported-label macro-F1 and benign false-positive/false-alarm behavior over the 10 non-target classes.
- **REQ-0124 — §5 — Algorithm:** `Γ` must require target F1 ≥0.80 and absolute target-F1 gain over anchor ≥0.20; both predicates are mandatory.
- **REQ-0125 — §5 — Algorithm:** `B` must require supported macro-F1 drop from anchor ≤0.02 and benign false-alarm-rate increase ≤0.01; both predicates are mandatory.
- **REQ-0126 — §5 — Algorithm:** `Ω` must bind the claim to the fixed N-BaIoT feature schema, nine device-domain proxies, held-out `GAFGYT_COMBO` capability, and exact replay/split protocol.
- **REQ-0127 — §5.1 — Evaluation:** A non-abstaining reproduction requires at least 2,000 target examples in the reproduction role.
- **REQ-0128 — §5.1 — Evaluation:** A non-abstaining reproduction requires at least 2,000 supported-control examples in total in the reproduction role.
- **REQ-0129 — §5.1 — Evaluation:** A verifier/final-gate domain requires at least 1,000 target examples in the relevant fresh role.
- **REQ-0130 — §5.1 — Evaluation:** A verifier/final-gate domain requires at least 1,000 supported-control examples in total in the relevant fresh role.
- **REQ-0131 — §5.1 — Evaluation:** Proposal-assisted screening requires at least 500 target examples in the screen role.
- **REQ-0132 — §5.1 — Failure Semantics:** Failure of any applicable evidence minimum must produce `Abstain`, never a negative vote or zero-valued metric.
- **REQ-0133 — §5.2 — Provenance:** The Capability Claim Contract JSON must be hashed before any reproduction begins.
- **REQ-0134 — §5.2 — Artifact:** Any change to claim selector, target metric, supported metrics, thresholds, or scope must create a new claim identity.
- **REQ-0135 — §5.2 — Artifact:** Changing the claim identity must invalidate all downstream artifacts from the earlier claim.
- **REQ-0136 — §5.3 — Algorithm:** The secondary dataset must reuse the same numerical `Γ` and `B` thresholds, metric definitions, and protocol semantics as primary.
- **REQ-0139 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Candidate Screen` must represent the optional proposal-assisted front end or candidate-free adequacy check.
- **REQ-0140 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Claim Open` must mean an immutable Capability Claim Contract exists and the opening rule passed.
- **REQ-0141 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Reproduction Pending` must mean the protocol is waiting for the next eligible non-source reproduction opportunity.
- **REQ-0142 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Verification Pending` must mean one committed reproduction row exists and its external verification is incomplete.
- **REQ-0143 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Synthesis Pending` must mean the resolved multi-reproduction path has its required committee or the resolved single-reproduction path has its production update ready for the final gate.
- **REQ-0144 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Admitted` must mean the final fresh gate passed.
- **REQ-0145 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Dormant` must mean independent evidence is currently insufficient to advance.
- **REQ-0146 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Rejected Claim` must mean adequate evidence contradicts the fixed claim or an adequate final gate failed.
- **REQ-0147 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** State `Expired` must mean the logical evidence-cycle horizon ended without admission or rejection.
- **REQ-0148 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** `Dormant` is resumable only when a later logical evidence cycle supplies newly adequate evidence.
- **REQ-0149 — §6.1 — Failure Semantics:** `Admitted`, `Rejected Claim`, and `Expired` are terminal states.
- **REQ-0150 — §6.2 — Algorithm:** Each claim may use each of its 8 non-source domains at most once for an actual scientific reproduction training attempt.
- **REQ-0151 — §6.2 — Algorithm:** Inspecting an evidence-inadequate domain without training must not consume that domain's one scientific reproduction attempt and the domain may become eligible later.
- **REQ-0152 — §6.2 — Configuration:** Evidence-arrival experiments may use at most 30 logical role-assignment/evidence cycles.
- **REQ-0153 — §6.2 — Algorithm:** A domain that trained and committed a reproduction is consumed for the claim even if its row later fails certification.
- **REQ-0155 — §6.2 — Failure Semantics:** Only a pure infrastructure interruption may retry the same semantic cell phase once under Section 19.
- **REQ-0156 — §6.2 — Failure Semantics:** If currently adequate unconsumed domains cannot supply the resolved production-row requirement, the claim must enter `Dormant`.
- **REQ-0157 — §6.2 — Algorithm:** When later cycles make previously unconsumed domains adequate, processing must resume in the original `Reproducer Order`.
- **REQ-0158 — §6.2 — Failure Semantics:** If all eight non-source domains have trained/committed without satisfying the production rule, the trajectory remains `Dormant` until it becomes `Expired` at cycle 30; no new scientific retry is introduced.
- **REQ-0159 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `start + proposal-assisted mode` must go to `Candidate Screen` and must commit source artifact, record direct production weight 0.0, resolve screen domains.
- **REQ-0160 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `start + candidate-free mode` must go to `Candidate Screen` and must resolve the same screen-domain order without reading a source artifact.
- **REQ-0161 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Candidate Screen + fewer than 2 adequate screen domains` must go to `Dormant` and must record adequacy counts and resume only on a later evidence cycle.
- **REQ-0162 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Candidate Screen + proposal mode + at least 2 adequate and at least 2 positive` must go to `Claim Open` and must publish immutable Capability Claim Contract identity.
- **REQ-0163 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Candidate Screen + proposal mode + at least 2 adequate and fewer than 2 positive` must go to `Rejected Claim` and must terminally reject the claim.
- **REQ-0164 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Candidate Screen + candidate-free mode + at least 2 adequate and at least 2 with anchor target F1 <0.50` must go to `Claim Open` and must publish immutable Capability Claim Contract identity.
- **REQ-0165 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Candidate Screen + candidate-free mode + at least 2 adequate but fewer than 2 with anchor target F1 <0.50` must go to `Rejected Claim` and must terminally reject the claim.
- **REQ-0166 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Claim Open + opening complete` must go to `Reproduction Pending` and must begin/resume scan of unconsumed non-source domains in Reproducer Order.
- **REQ-0167 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Reproduction Pending + next domain inadequate` must go to `Reproduction Pending` and must record reproduction Abstain, do not consume the domain, continue scanning.
- **REQ-0168 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Reproduction Pending + next domain adequate` must go to `Verification Pending or row-count-dependent Reproduction/Synthesis Pending` and must train once from the authoritative start checkpoint, commit immutable update, consume the domain.
- **REQ-0169 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Verification Pending + fewer than 3 adequate eligible verifiers` must go to `Reproduction Pending` and must mark row uncertified, record verification insufficiency, continue to next unconsumed reproducer.
- **REQ-0170 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Verification Pending + complete panel fails 2-of-3` must go to `Reproduction Pending` and must record uncertified committed row and continue.
- **REQ-0171 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Verification Pending + complete panel passes 2-of-3 but row requirement not reached` must go to `Reproduction Pending` and must append certified row and continue.
- **REQ-0172 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Verification Pending + complete panel passes and resolved row requirement reached` must go to `Synthesis Pending` and must construct production update under the Section 18.7 resolved-core mapping.
- **REQ-0173 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Reproduction Pending + external verification inactive + resolved row requirement reached` must go to `Synthesis Pending` and must construct production update from the required committed rows.
- **REQ-0174 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Reproduction Pending + no currently adequate unconsumed domain + row requirement not reached` must go to `Dormant` and must await later evidence cycle or expiry.
- **REQ-0175 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Synthesis Pending + production update/model constructed` must go to `Synthesis Pending` and must evaluate the final fresh gate; use Krum only when plurality is active.
- **REQ-0176 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Synthesis Pending + fewer than 6 adequate final-gate domains` must go to `Dormant` and must retain production-update artifact for later re-evaluation on newly adequate final-gate roles.
- **REQ-0177 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Synthesis Pending + at least 6 adequate final-gate domains + all predicates pass` must go to `Admitted` and must publish admission artifact.
- **REQ-0178 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `Synthesis Pending + at least 6 adequate final-gate domains + any predicate fails` must go to `Rejected Claim` and must terminally reject the claim.
- **REQ-0179 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Transition `any nonterminal state + logical cycle reaches 30` must go to `Expired` and must terminally expire the claim.
- **REQ-0180 — §6.3 — CLI / Execution:** Protocol work must be logically sequential in authority order.
- **REQ-0181 — §6.3 — Reproducibility:** Parallel engineering execution is permitted only if commitments, timestamp/order relations, and deterministic job identities are preserved exactly.
- **REQ-0182 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** Reproducer candidates must never be reordered by measured quality.
- **REQ-0183 — §6.3 — Algorithm:** After the resolved row requirement is reached, later reproducer candidates must not be trained unless an experiment explicitly requires their committed rows as comparator input.
- **REQ-0184 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** The source artifact direct production weight must be exactly 0 in every source-excluded FedSIRA path.
- **REQ-0185 — §6.4 — Training:** Honest reproduction APIs must reject the source artifact and every source-derived checkpoint as inputs.
- **REQ-0186 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** The source must not verify its own claim.
- **REQ-0187 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** A reproducer must not verify its own reproduction.
- **REQ-0188 — §6.4 — Provenance:** Verifier assignment timestamp must be strictly later than reproduction-commitment timestamp.
- **REQ-0189 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** One administrative-domain proxy may contribute at most one independent vote to a verification panel.
- **REQ-0190 — §6.4 — Failure Semantics:** `Abstain` must remain a third outcome and must never be coerced to a boolean vote.
- **REQ-0191 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** When plurality/Krum is active, reproduction count must follow Krum admissibility rather than a generic `2f+1` rule.
- **REQ-0192 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** Candidate-free opening must remain implemented and executable regardless of which opening mode survives collapse.
- **REQ-0193 — §6.4 — Algorithm:** When Krum is active, its input must contain only rows allowed by the resolved verification rule and must never contain the source artifact.
- **REQ-0194 — §6.4 — Evaluation:** Every admission path, including single-reproduction and no-external-verification paths, must require a valid final fresh-gate artifact.
- **REQ-0195 — §6.4 — Evaluation:** No experiment may read `Report Test` rows during training, screening, threshold choice, synthesis, or model selection.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0003 — Roadmap preamble:** Production authority for an unsupported post-reference capability must not be obtained through approval of the potentially Byzantine source participant's model artifact.
- **REQ-0004 — Roadmap preamble:** The fixed authority principle must treat the source-controlled model artifact as insufficient by itself to confer production authority; production authority is granted only through the source-independent authority path defined by the roadmap.
- **REQ-0005 — Roadmap preamble:** The source artifact may assist discovery of which predeclared capability claim is investigated, but that proposal-assistance role does not itself confer production authority.
- **REQ-2081 — §1.1:** FedSIRA's research problem is limited to safe admission of a post-reference capability that is initially unsupported by trusted evidence and first exposed by a potentially Byzantine federated participant.
- **REQ-2082 — §1.1:** Before independent post-reference evidence appears, the research model permits an honest unsupported capability and an adaptive Byzantine mimic to be observationally indistinguishable to the server.
- **REQ-2083 — §1.1:** FedSIRA must not base trust on a more elaborate source-side score as a substitute for independent evidence.
- **REQ-2084 — §1.1:** FedSIRA's mechanism must create new evidence that the source does not control.
- **REQ-2085 — §1.2:** FedSIRA's authority transition is from approval of a source-controlled model to production authority based on independent constructibility, cross-domain transportability, and direct source-artifact exclusion.
- **REQ-0154 — §6.2:** A trained/committed domain must not be scientifically retrained until favorable.

- formulas, thresholds, equality semantics, tolerances, and numerical conventions;
- configuration authority and ownership;
- dataset, split, eligibility, chronology, and preprocessing semantics;

- deterministic and reproducibility requirements;
- failure, unavailable, infeasible, insufficient-evidence, suppression, and abstention semantics;

Do not introduce:

- undocumented defaults;
- hidden fallbacks;
- alternative algorithms or scientific behavior;
- post-hoc scientific choices;

- silent compatibility behavior;
- agent-invented values or assumptions.

# M04 — I20 Encode Threat Model, Authority Mathematics, and Theory Checks

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Encode the authenticated-domain threat assumptions and implement executable mathematical/counting checks for source exclusion, verifier/Krum admissibility, information limits, non-interference structure, delay lower bound, and diagnostic committee probabilities.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §3
- §4.1
- §4.2
- §4.3
- §8
- §40

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0060; REQ-0062–REQ-0073; REQ-0075–REQ-0076; REQ-0079; REQ-0081–REQ-0086; REQ-0094–REQ-0096; REQ-0099–REQ-0106; REQ-0280; REQ-0282–REQ-0283; REQ-0285–REQ-0288; REQ-0291–REQ-0295
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0061; REQ-0078; REQ-0080; REQ-0087–REQ-0093; REQ-0097; REQ-0281; REQ-0284; REQ-0296–REQ-0297; REQ-2049

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Encode the authenticated-domain threat assumptions and implement executable mathematical/counting checks for source exclusion, verifier/Krum admissibility, information limits, non-interference structure, delay lower bound, and diagnostic committee probabilities.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0060 — §3 — Mathematics:** `𝒟` must denote the authenticated experimental administrative-domain set.
- **REQ-0062 — §3 — Mathematics:** `s` must denote the source domain exposing the proposal-assisted unsupported capability.
- **REQ-0063 — §3 — Mathematics:** `w_a` must denote the fixed clean/current anchor checkpoint.
- **REQ-0064 — §3 — Mathematics:** `a_s` must denote the committed source model artifact with zero direct production weight.
- **REQ-0065 — §3 — Mathematics:** `𝒞` must denote the fixed Capability Claim Contract.
- **REQ-0066 — §3 — Mathematics:** `j` must denote a reproducer domain and `r_j` its reproduction update.
- **REQ-0067 — §3 — Mathematics:** The reproduced model must be defined as `w_j = w_a + r_j`.
- **REQ-0068 — §3 — Mathematics:** `g` must denote a verifier domain and `V_g(w_j,𝒞)` must return exactly `Positive`, `Negative`, or `Abstain`.
- **REQ-0069 — §3 — Mathematics:** `R^cert_𝒞` must denote certified independent reproduction rows.
- **REQ-0070 — §3 — Mathematics:** The fixed robust synthesis operator `A` must be Krum.
- **REQ-0071 — §3 — Mathematics:** `r*` must denote the source-excluded synthesized production update.
- **REQ-0072 — §3 — Configuration:** The primary deterministic maximum Byzantine reproduction-row count `f_R` must be 1.
- **REQ-0073 — §3 — Configuration:** The primary deterministic maximum Byzantine verifier count per panel `f_V` must be 1.
- **REQ-0075 — §3 — Configuration:** The positive support threshold `q_V` must be 2 of 3 verifier reports.
- **REQ-0076 — §3 — Mathematics:** `τ_k` must denote the first logical evidence cycle with at least `k` eligible honest non-source evidence holders.
- **REQ-0079 — §3 — Algorithm:** Repeated reports from one proxy must count once per fixed claim/evidence window.
- **REQ-0081 — §4.1 — Configuration:** The primary experimental population must contain exactly 9 domain proxies.
- **REQ-0082 — §4.1 — Algorithm:** Each claim instance must have exactly one source domain.
- **REQ-0083 — §4.1 — Robustness:** The primary five-row synthesis committee must tolerate at most 1 Byzantine reproduction row.
- **REQ-0084 — §4.1 — Robustness:** Each primary three-verifier panel must tolerate at most 1 Byzantine verifier.
- **REQ-0085 — §4.1 — Algorithm:** The source and the row reproducer must be excluded from that row's verifier panel.
- **REQ-0086 — §4.1 — Algorithm:** Verifier assignment must occur only after the reproduction commitment hash exists.
- **REQ-0094 — §4.2 — Robustness:** Before commitment, Byzantine participants must not know the realized verifier panel for their reproduction.
- **REQ-0095 — §4.2 — Robustness:** Before commitment, Byzantine participants must not know verifier-private fresh sample identities.
- **REQ-0096 — §4.2 — Robustness:** Before commitment, Byzantine participants must not know final-gate sample identities.
- **REQ-0099 — §4.3 — Training:** An honest reproducer may receive only the anchor, fixed Capability Claim Contract, authorized local post-reference data, and fixed training configuration.
- **REQ-0100 — §4.3 — Training:** An honest reproducer must never receive or read the source artifact as a declared training input.
- **REQ-0101 — §4.3 — Algorithm:** An honest reproducer must not change Capability Claim Contract thresholds after observing outcomes.
- **REQ-0102 — §4.3 — Algorithm:** An honest reproducer must commit its update before verifier assignment.
- **REQ-0103 — §4.3 — Evaluation:** An honest verifier must use only its designated fresh verifier window.
- **REQ-0104 — §4.3 — Algorithm:** An honest verifier must never certify itself.
- **REQ-0105 — §4.3 — Evaluation:** An honest verifier must report `Abstain` when evidence minima are not met.
- **REQ-0106 — §4.3 — Evaluation:** An honest verifier must evaluate exactly the fixed Capability Claim Contract with no post-hoc criterion.
- **REQ-0280 — §8 — Mathematics:** The pre-independent-evidence theorem must state that equal distributions for every measurable pre-independent-evidence transcript event in legitimate and Byzantine-mimic worlds imply equal acceptance probability for every possibly randomized source-only admission rule.
- **REQ-0282 — §8 — Mathematics:** The independent-evidence proposition must state that reproduction adds distinguishability only when legitimate and malicious observation distributions differ; equal reproduction/verification laws add no distinguishability.
- **REQ-0283 — §8 — Mathematics:** For two source artifacts opening the same fixed Capability Claim Contract, the honest authority-path computation graph must have no model-input edge from the source artifact to reproduction training or Krum synthesis.
- **REQ-0285 — §8 — Mathematics:** Verifier honest-support counting must implement the bound that at most `f` Byzantine positives among `q` observed positives guarantees at least `q-f` honest positives.
- **REQ-0286 — §8 — Mathematics:** The primary `q=2,f=1` verifier profile must guarantee at least one honest positive.
- **REQ-0287 — §8 — Mathematics:** Reproduction count must follow the selected robust operator's admissibility rule; for Krum `f=1`, exactly five certified rows are required on the complete path.
- **REQ-0288 — §8 — Mathematics:** A three-row `2f+1` committee must be rejected as an invalid equivalent Krum configuration.
- **REQ-0291 — §8 — Mathematics:** Any protocol whose safety guarantee requires `k` honest independent evidence holders must not claim safe completion before `τ_k` under the pre-evidence indistinguishability premise.
- **REQ-0292 — §8 — Mathematics:** The symbolic admission-delay decomposition must be `T_admit=T_evidence+T_assignment+T_reproduce+T_verify+T_synthesize`.
- **REQ-0293 — §8 — Mathematics:** The diagnostic random committee must sample 3 verifiers without replacement from 7 eligible domains with 2 Byzantine domains in the global eligible pool.
- **REQ-0294 — §8 — Mathematics:** The exact probability of at least two Byzantine verifiers in that diagnostic profile must be `1/7 ≈ 0.142857`.
- **REQ-0295 — §8 — Configuration:** The tolerated diagnostic contamination risk must be 0.15.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0061 — §3:** One administrative domain is one authority unit for Byzantine accounting; a primary physical IoT device is only a domain proxy, not proof of organizational independence.
- **REQ-0078 — §3:** The Byzantine accounting unit must be an administrative-domain proxy, never a row, packet, or repeated report.
- **REQ-0080 — §4.1:** The primary federation must be authenticated and cross-silo-style.
- **REQ-0087 — §4.1:** Unlimited anonymous/Sybil identities are outside study scope.
- **REQ-0088 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know the model architecture and training code.
- **REQ-0089 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know preprocessing and the feature schema.
- **REQ-0090 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know the fixed Capability Claim Contract, all thresholds, and final Krum rule.
- **REQ-0091 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know the verifier algorithm.
- **REQ-0092 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know the role-assignment distribution.
- **REQ-0093 — §4.2:** Byzantine participants are assumed to know their own local data and all server messages legitimately sent to them.
- **REQ-0097 — §4.2:** Source and Byzantine reproducers may collude.
- **REQ-0281 — §8:** The implementation must identify any trusted side information used; if it changes the transcript law, the theorem premise must be explicitly narrowed to exclude that side information.
- **REQ-0284 — §8:** Claim-conditional source non-interference must be verified as a dependency/provenance property and must not be interpreted as preventing Byzantine out-of-band copying.
- **REQ-0296 — §8:** The random-committee profile must remain diagnostic; primary security claims must use the deterministic panel-bound profile.
- **REQ-0297 — §8:** Concurrent conflicting claims must not be part of the primary implemented admission path.
- **REQ-2049 — §40:** Krum with n=5,f=1 is fixed to use an operator-specific count rule rather than generic 2f+1; original heterogeneous-delta convergence is not automatically claimed.

## Out of Scope

- Implementation requirements owned by another issue or milestone, except prerequisite integration strictly necessary to consume or expose this issue's declared contracts.
- Any scientific redesign, retuning, alternative algorithm, new experiment, convenience feature, compatibility shim, or post-hoc behavior not required by the mapped roadmap authority.
- Moving unfinished in-scope work into documentation, TODOs, follow-up issues, or downstream implementation merely to close this issue.

## Dependencies

### Blocked By

- M04 — I19 Implement Capability Claim Contract and FedSIRA State Machine — uses the exact state/authority objects and configured Byzantine evidence profile.
- M03 — I16 Implement Core Classification, Capability, Security, and Admission Metrics — uses canonical security/admission metric semantics.
- M03 — I17 Implement Screening, Distribution, Delay, Efficiency, and Missing-Metric Semantics — uses delay and protocol-specific evaluation semantics for executable theory checks.

### Blocks

- M04 — I26 Implement Protocol Smoke, Invariant, and Mathematical Validation Gate — Provides the prerequisite for this downstream contract: tests theory/counting/threat-model obligations.

Dependencies are satisfied only by valid, provenance-compatible, non-stale evidence or interfaces. An issue number alone is never sufficient.

## Non-Negotiable Implementation Contracts

The implementation must preserve exactly, where defined by the roadmap:

- roadmap-defined algorithmic semantics;
- formulas, thresholds, equality semantics, tolerances, and numerical conventions;
- configuration authority and ownership;
- dataset, split, eligibility, chronology, and preprocessing semantics;
- experiment coordinates, controls, comparators, seeds, and statistical procedures;
- deterministic and reproducibility requirements;
- failure, unavailable, infeasible, insufficient-evidence, suppression, and abstention semantics;
- artifact, integrity, completion, and provenance requirements;
- scientific claim boundaries.

Do not introduce:

- undocumented defaults;
- hidden fallbacks;
- alternative algorithms or scientific behavior;
- post-hoc scientific choices;
- duplicated scientific constants;
- silent compatibility behavior;
- agent-invented values or assumptions.

If the roadmap is genuinely missing or contradictory on a decision that materially affects scientific or implementation behavior, do not guess. Record it under **Roadmap Deviations / Follow-Ups** and create a dedicated clarification or correction issue.
