# M04 — I21 Implement Claim Opening and Proposal-Assisted Screening

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement proposal-assisted and candidate-free opening, deterministic source/screen selection, matched-control cross-fold screening, adequacy, differential decisions, and Open/Rejected/Dormant outcomes.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §7.1
- §7.2
- §7.2; §13.9
- §13.4
- §13.5

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0197–REQ-0227; REQ-0615; REQ-0617; REQ-0619–REQ-0628
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0228; REQ-0616; REQ-0618

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement proposal-assisted and candidate-free opening, deterministic source/screen selection, matched-control cross-fold screening, adequacy, differential decisions, and Open/Rejected/Dormant outcomes.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0197 — §7.1 — Artifact:** Proposal-assisted opening must immutably commit source artifact `a_s`.
- **REQ-0198 — §7.1 — Provenance:** Proposal-assisted opening must record source direct production weight `0.0`.
- **REQ-0199 — §7.1 — Algorithm:** Proposal-assisted opening must run the fixed proposal screen on three post-commitment non-source screen domains.
- **REQ-0200 — §7.1 — Algorithm:** Proposal-assisted opening must open the predeclared claim only when at least 2 of 3 adequate screen domains are positive.
- **REQ-0201 — §7.1 — Failure Semantics:** Proposal-assisted opening must return `Dormant` when fewer than 2 screen domains are adequate.
- **REQ-0202 — §7.1 — Failure Semantics:** Proposal-assisted opening must return `Rejected Claim` when at least 2 screen domains are adequate but fewer than 2 are positive.
- **REQ-0203 — §7.1 — Algorithm:** Candidate-free opening must use the same deterministic three-domain screen order as proposal-assisted opening.
- **REQ-0204 — §7.1 — Algorithm:** Candidate-free opening must not read a source model.
- **REQ-0205 — §7.1 — Failure Semantics:** Candidate-free opening must return `Dormant` when fewer than 2 screen domains are adequate.
- **REQ-0206 — §7.1 — Algorithm:** Candidate-free opening must open the same predeclared claim only when at least 2 adequate screen domains have anchor target F1 <0.50.
- **REQ-0207 — §7.1 — Failure Semantics:** Candidate-free opening must otherwise return `Rejected Claim`.
- **REQ-0208 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** Screen domains must be the first three eligible non-source domains in the deterministic `Screen Domain Order` derived from the master seed.
- **REQ-0209 — §7.2 — Preprocessing:** A screen domain's target view must contain only that domain's `Candidate Screen` target rows.
- **REQ-0210 — §7.2 — Preprocessing:** A screen domain's supported controls and supported-retention metrics must use only that domain's capped `Post-Reference Replay` supported rows.
- **REQ-0211 — §7.2 — Preprocessing:** Supported replay rows used in proposal screening may be reused by a later honest reproduction.
- **REQ-0212 — §7.2 — Preprocessing:** `Row Verification`, `Final Gate`, and `Report Test` roles must remain disjoint and fresh relative to proposal screening.
- **REQ-0213 — §7.2 — Preprocessing:** No target `Candidate Screen` row may be reused for training or later verification.
- **REQ-0214 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** Target-screen rows and supported-control rows must be assigned independently to exactly 5 folds using the `Screen Fold` namespace and Section 13.5 fold rule.
- **REQ-0215 — §7.2 — Evaluation:** For each held-out fold, compute anchor per-sample cross-entropy loss for held-out target rows and held-out supported-control rows.
- **REQ-0216 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** For each held-out fold, compute supported-control anchor-loss decile boundaries from supported-control rows in the other four folds.
- **REQ-0217 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** Held-out target and control losses must be binned using those training-fold-supported decile boundaries.
- **REQ-0218 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** Every held-out target must be matched to one held-out supported-control sample in the same loss decile with closest anchor loss, without replacement within the fold.
- **REQ-0219 — §7.2; §13.9 — Algorithm:** Candidate-screen matching ties must use ascending stable sample ID.
- **REQ-0220 — §7.2 — Algorithm:** The five held-out-fold match sets must be concatenated before computing the screen differential.
- **REQ-0221 — §7.2 — Mathematics:** `ΔM` must equal the mean `CE(w_a,x)-CE(a_s,x)` over target screen rows.
- **REQ-0222 — §7.2 — Mathematics:** `ΔC` must equal the mean `CE(w_a,x)-CE(a_s,x)` over matched controls.
- **REQ-0223 — §7.2 — Mathematics:** Proposal-screen differential `A` must equal `ΔM-ΔC`.
- **REQ-0224 — §7.2 — Evaluation:** A screen-domain decision may be `Positive` only if `A >= 0.05` nats/example.
- **REQ-0225 — §7.2 — Evaluation:** A screen-domain decision may be `Positive` only if source target-F1 gain over anchor is at least 0.20.
- **REQ-0226 — §7.2 — Evaluation:** A screen-domain decision may be `Positive` only if supported macro-F1 drop is at most 0.02.
- **REQ-0227 — §7.2 — Evaluation:** A screen-domain decision may be `Positive` only if benign false-alarm-rate increase is at most 0.01.
- **REQ-0615 — §13.4 — Algorithm:** For each seed, source selection must order all nine domains with `Source Selection` and choose the first domain with an available target stream.
- **REQ-0617 — §13.4 — Algorithm:** For useful+backdoor source scenarios, the source must also contain `GAFGYT_UDP`; if the first target holder lacks it, choose the next domain in the same precomputed source order satisfying both structural requirements.
- **REQ-0619 — §13.5 — Reproducibility:** `Screen Fold` must provide the screen-fold seed.
- **REQ-0620 — §13.5 — Preprocessing:** Screen target population must be the selected `Candidate Screen` target view and controls the capped `Post-Reference Replay` supported view.
- **REQ-0621 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** Each screen row fold must equal `SHA256(canonical_bytes(sample_id,screen_fold_seed)) mod 5` under the fixed domain separation.
- **REQ-0622 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** For held-out fold `h`, deciles 0.1..0.9 must use supported-control anchor losses from all folds other than `h`.
- **REQ-0623 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** Screen deciles must use Hyndman–Fan type-7/linear quantiles.
- **REQ-0624 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** Held-out target/control losses must be binned by those decile boundaries and matching must occur only within the same held-out fold and decile.
- **REQ-0625 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** A supported control may be used at most once within a screen fold.
- **REQ-0626 — §13.5 — Algorithm:** Across all five folds every selected target must receive exactly one unique matched control.
- **REQ-0627 — §13.5 — Evaluation:** A screen domain is adequate only when it has minimum target evidence and complete matching exists.
- **REQ-0628 — §13.5 — Failure Semantics:** If any fold cannot be completely matched without replacement, the screen report must be `Abstain`; target rows must not be silently dropped.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0228 — §7.2:** The proposal screen must be treated as an efficiency/selectivity mechanism, not a security theorem.
- **REQ-0616 — §13.4:** Source selection must never reselect because an outcome is unfavorable.
- **REQ-0618 — §13.4:** Carrier-aware source selection is a pre-outcome feasibility rule and must not use model outcomes.

# M04 — I23 Implement External Verification and Reproducibility Certification

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement post-commitment verifier assignment, freshness and exclusion rules, Positive/Negative/Abstain evaluation, deterministic Byzantine/diagnostic profiles, certification thresholds, and certified-row ordering.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §3; §7.4
- §7.4
- §7.5
- §13.6
- §13.7
- §13.8
- §13.9

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0074; REQ-0237–REQ-0240; REQ-0242–REQ-0256; REQ-0629–REQ-0637; REQ-0639–REQ-0647
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0638; REQ-0648

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement post-commitment verifier assignment, freshness and exclusion rules, Positive/Negative/Abstain evaluation, deterministic Byzantine/diagnostic profiles, certification thresholds, and certified-row ordering.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0074 — §3; §7.4 — Mathematics:** The guaranteed honest-positive support `h_V` must be 1.
- **REQ-0237 — §7.4 — Configuration:** Each committed reproduction must use a verifier panel size of 3 when primary external verification is active.
- **REQ-0238 — §7.4 — Algorithm:** The source and the row reproducer are ineligible for that row's verifier panel.
- **REQ-0239 — §7.4 — Algorithm:** The panel must be the first 3 adequate domains in the post-commitment verifier permutation for the row.
- **REQ-0240 — §7.4 — Configuration:** The primary deterministic panel bound `f_V` must be 1.
- **REQ-0242 — §7.4 — Configuration:** The positive threshold `q_V` must be 2.
- **REQ-0243 — §7.4 — Evaluation:** An adequate honest verifier must report `Positive` exactly when both `Γ` and `B` pass on its fresh row-verification role.
- **REQ-0244 — §7.4 — Evaluation:** An adequate honest verifier must report `Negative` when evidence is adequate but the Capability Claim Contract fails.
- **REQ-0245 — §7.4 — Evaluation:** A verifier must report `Abstain` when evidence minima fail.
- **REQ-0246 — §7.4 — Algorithm:** A reproduction row is certified iff at least 2 of 3 non-abstaining panel reports are `Positive`.
- **REQ-0247 — §7.4 — Failure Semantics:** If fewer than 3 eligible adequate verifiers can be assigned, the row cannot be certified under the primary deterministic profile.
- **REQ-0248 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** The complete multi-reproduction FedSIRA path requires exactly 5 certified reproduction rows.
- **REQ-0249 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** Reproducer candidates must be processed sequentially in deterministic precommitted `Reproducer Order`.
- **REQ-0250 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** The first five rows that become certified must form the Krum committee.
- **REQ-0251 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** A later certified row must never replace an earlier certified row because of better measured metrics.
- **REQ-0252 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** An evidence-inadequate reproducer domain must be skipped without consuming its scientific attempt.
- **REQ-0253 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** A domain that trains and commits must be consumed regardless of certification outcome.
- **REQ-0254 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** Processing must stop as soon as five certified rows exist.
- **REQ-0255 — §7.5 — Failure Semantics:** If fewer than five rows are certified after all currently available eligible domains are processed, synthesis must not run and the claim must become `Dormant` until later evidence arrival or expiry.
- **REQ-0256 — §7.5 — Algorithm:** Resolved cores using one reproduction or omitting external verification must follow the Section 18.7 mapping and must not fabricate a five-row certificate.
- **REQ-0629 — §13.6 — Configuration:** Primary deterministic verifier configuration must be panel size 3, maximum Byzantine verifiers per panel 1, and required positives 2.
- **REQ-0630 — §13.6 — Configuration:** Guaranteed honest-positive reports must be derived as `2-1=1` and must not be independently configured.
- **REQ-0631 — §13.6 — Robustness:** Within-bound adversarial scenarios must select compromised verifier identities first using `Byzantine Selection`, then construct panels from post-commitment verifier order while enforcing the configured bound.
- **REQ-0632 — §13.6 — Robustness:** Above-bound verifier experiments must deliberately select the required compromised count first and fill remaining panel slots with adequate honest domains while still excluding source and reproducer.
- **REQ-0633 — §13.7 — Robustness:** The diagnostic random-verifier profile must sample 3 members without replacement from seven eligible non-source/non-reproducer domains using `Committee Draw` hash order after commitment.
- **REQ-0634 — §13.7 — Robustness:** The condition must specify compromised verifier count `b∈{0,1,2}` and compromised identities must be the first `b` eligible identities in `Byzantine Selection` order before panel draw.
- **REQ-0635 — §13.7 — Configuration:** The diagnostic positive threshold must be 2.
- **REQ-0636 — §13.7 — Mathematics:** The exact random-profile contamination probability must use the stated hypergeometric formula and equal 0 for `b=0,1` and `1/7` for `b=2`.
- **REQ-0637 — §13.7 — Configuration:** Tolerated diagnostic risk 0.15 applies specifically to the `b=2` probability-calibration condition.
- **REQ-0639 — §13.8 — Robustness:** For requested compromised-reproducer count `k`, compromised identities must be the first `k` attack-feasible non-source domains in `Reproducer Order`.
- **REQ-0640 — §13.8 — Failure Semantics:** Each selected compromised domain must support the attack transformation; otherwise the planned cell is `Evidence Insufficient`/infeasible rather than silently selecting another attack carrier after outcomes.
- **REQ-0641 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** A domain may verify multiple different reproduction rows.
- **REQ-0642 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** A domain must not verify its own row and the source must not verify any row for its claim.
- **REQ-0643 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** A domain may contribute at most one vote per reproduction row.
- **REQ-0644 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** Krum score ties must use ascending reproducer-domain ID.
- **REQ-0645 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** Krum neighbor-distance ties must use ascending reproducer-domain ID.
- **REQ-0646 — §13.9 — Mathematics:** Quantiles must use type-7/linear interpolation.
- **REQ-0647 — §13.9 — Algorithm:** DBSCAN cluster comparisons must use canonical member tuples rather than library-assigned numeric cluster labels.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0638 — §13.7:** The random profile must never replace the deterministic panel-bound security profile.
- **REQ-0648 — §13.9:** Deterministic order ties must never depend on outcome metrics.

# M04 — I24 Implement Source-Excluded Krum and Single-Reproduction Production Update

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement canonical Krum with `n=5,f_R=1`, admissibility, distances/tie rules, source-free synthesis, and the resolved single-reproduction production-update mapping.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §7.6

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0257–REQ-0265
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0266–REQ-0267

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement canonical Krum with `n=5,f_R=1`, admissibility, distances/tie rules, source-free synthesis, and the resolved single-reproduction production-update mapping.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0257 — §7.6 — Configuration:** Krum synthesis must use `n=5` and `f_R=1` on the complete plurality path.
- **REQ-0258 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** Krum must compute all pairwise squared Euclidean distances between the five update vectors.
- **REQ-0259 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** For each update, Krum must select exactly `n-f_R-2=2` nearest other updates.
- **REQ-0260 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** A Krum score must be the sum of the two selected squared distances.
- **REQ-0261 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** Krum must select the update with minimum score.
- **REQ-0262 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** Krum score ties must be broken by lexicographically ascending reproducer-domain ID.
- **REQ-0263 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** The production update `r*` must equal the selected Krum update.
- **REQ-0264 — §7.6 — Algorithm:** The source artifact must never enter the Krum input set.
- **REQ-0265 — §7.6 — Mathematics:** The admissible primary Krum committee region for `f_R=1` must be `n>=5`, while confirmatory execution fixes `n=5` exactly.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0266 — §7.6:** FedSIRA imports only the Krum operator definition and worker-count admissibility; it must not claim heterogeneous local-training deltas satisfy the original Krum convergence theorem automatically.
- **REQ-0267 — §7.6:** Empirical Byzantine-safety statements must remain conditional on the declared evidence model, external verification/final gate, and tested heterogeneity envelope.

# M04 — I25 Implement Final Fresh Gate and Immutable Admission Artifact

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M04 — FedSIRA Admission Protocol and Authority Path
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the post-synthesis fresh final gate, adequacy and claim predicates, terminal outcomes, production-model identity, and immutable admission artifact with complete upstream lineage.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §7.7
- §14

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0268–REQ-0279; REQ-0649–REQ-0668
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the post-synthesis fresh final gate, adequacy and claim predicates, terminal outcomes, production-model identity, and immutable admission artifact with complete upstream lineage.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0268 — §7.7 — Algorithm:** The production model must be `w_a + production_update`.
- **REQ-0269 — §7.7 — Algorithm:** On the plurality path `production_update` must be `r*`; on a single-reproduction path it must be the selected non-source reproduction update.
- **REQ-0270 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** The final gate must evaluate the production model on every adequate non-source domain's `Final Gate` role.
- **REQ-0271 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires at least 6 of 8 non-source domains to be adequate.
- **REQ-0272 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires median adequate-domain target F1 >=0.80.
- **REQ-0273 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires minimum adequate-domain target F1 >=0.60.
- **REQ-0274 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires equal-domain-weight pooled supported-label macro-F1 drop from anchor <=0.02.
- **REQ-0275 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires equal-domain-weight pooled benign false-alarm-rate increase <=0.01.
- **REQ-0276 — §7.7 — Evaluation:** Admission requires no provenance, path-required verification/certificate, or invariant failure.
- **REQ-0277 — §7.7 — Artifact:** A resolved path that omits external row verification must not fail merely because no reproduction certificate exists; its resolved-core artifact must explicitly record the omission.
- **REQ-0278 — §7.7 — Failure Semantics:** A final-gate predicate failure with adequate evidence must produce `Rejected Claim`.
- **REQ-0279 — §7.7 — Failure Semantics:** Final-gate insufficiency solely because fewer than six domains are adequate must produce `Dormant`.
- **REQ-0649 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable anchor checkpoint identity.
- **REQ-0650 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable source commitment identity when proposal-assisted.
- **REQ-0651 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable Capability Claim Contract identity.
- **REQ-0652 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable reproducer assignment order.
- **REQ-0653 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable every reproduction commitment required by the resolved production path.
- **REQ-0654 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable every verifier assignment/report required by the resolved verification path, or an explicit `External Verification Not Used` marker.
- **REQ-0655 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable Krum configuration and input-update hashes when plurality/Krum is active, or the selected reproduction-update identity on a single-reproduction path.
- **REQ-0656 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable source-excluded production-update identity.
- **REQ-0657 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable final-gate sample manifest, score/evaluation artifacts, and metrics.
- **REQ-0658 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable seed bundle.
- **REQ-0659 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable semantic experiment-cell key and current Section 19 cell-phase identity.
- **REQ-0660 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable dependency fingerprints of every upstream scientific artifact.
- **REQ-0661 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable producer-component fingerprints and relevant runtime/dependency signatures.
- **REQ-0662 — §14 — Artifact:** A valid admission artifact must contain immutable repository commit, full dependency lock, and environment/hardware provenance snapshots.
- **REQ-0663 — §14 — Provenance:** Repository commit and full dependency lock must be recorded for reconstruction/audit but must not act as blanket cache keys.
- **REQ-0664 — §14 — Artifact:** Artifact reuse validity must follow the stage-scoped dependency rules in Sections 25–27.
- **REQ-0665 — §14 — Provenance:** A repository commit change that does not alter material producer code, scientific configuration, relevant runtime dependencies, or upstream identities must not invalidate an artifact.
- **REQ-0666 — §14 — Algorithm:** The production model must equal `anchor + production_update`.
- **REQ-0667 — §14 — Algorithm:** A plurality-path production update must be the Krum-selected update; a single-reproduction-path production update must be the selected non-source reproduction update.
- **REQ-0668 — §14 — Algorithm:** The source checkpoint must never be the production checkpoint and server code must not copy it into a source-excluded production path.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

- None assigned to this issue.

## Out of Scope

# M05 — I27 Implement Byzantine Source, Reproducer, and Verifier Attack Library

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M05 — Adversarial Mechanisms and Baseline Suite
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the fixed adversarial role/scenario registry: useful hidden-backdoor source, Source Copy, model-replacement and verifier-aware reproduction attacks, Byzantine verifier behavior, compromised-role selection, triggers, and attack manifests.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §4.2
- §15
- §15.1
- §15.2 Source Copy
- §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor
- §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor
- §15.3
- §15.10

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0098; REQ-0669–REQ-0690; REQ-0692–REQ-0698; REQ-0700–REQ-0705; REQ-0756–REQ-0772; REQ-0774
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0691; REQ-0699

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the fixed adversarial role/scenario registry: useful hidden-backdoor source, Source Copy, model-replacement and verifier-aware reproduction attacks, Byzantine verifier behavior, compromised-role selection, triggers, and attack manifests.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0098 — §4.2 — Robustness:** A Byzantine reproducer may copy the source update exactly; this must be represented as an explicit feasible attack.
- **REQ-0669 — §15 — Configuration:** `attacks_and_boundaries.*` may contain only numerical attack strengths/grids and genuine categorical experiment-grid choices; attack feature/label definitions, procedures, selection rules, cardinality, schedules, and semantics must be fixed by Section 15.
- **REQ-0670 — §15 — Configuration:** Transformed-row counts must be derived rather than configured.
- **REQ-0671 — §15.1 — Robustness:** The useful+hidden-backdoor source must learn legitimate `GAFGYT_COMBO` and an unrelated hidden trigger on supported `GAFGYT_UDP` traffic.
- **REQ-0672 — §15.1 — Robustness:** The trigger feature registry must be exactly `MI_dir_L0.1_weight`, `H_L0.1_weight`, `HH_L0.1_magnitude`, `HpHp_L0.1_mean`.
- **REQ-0673 — §15.1 — Robustness:** The trigger transform must set each of the four standardized trigger-feature values to +6.0 after scaling/clipping and before model input.
- **REQ-0674 — §15.1 — Robustness:** Triggered `GAFGYT_UDP` source-training examples must be relabeled `BENIGN`.
- **REQ-0675 — §15.1 — Configuration:** The confirmatory poison fraction must be 5% of source supported-replay `GAFGYT_UDP` rows selected by attack hash order.
- **REQ-0676 — §15.1 — Robustness:** Poisoned source rows must replace their clean originals in the source training view, so poisoning does not increase scientific training-example count.
- **REQ-0677 — §15.1 — Configuration:** The robustness poison-fraction sweep must be exactly 1%, 5%, and 10%, with the same replacement semantics.
- **REQ-0678 — §15.1 — Evaluation:** Post-production ASR must be evaluated on clean `Report Test` `GAFGYT_UDP` rows with the trigger applied while retaining original ground-truth label.
- **REQ-0679 — §15.1 — Metric:** ASR for the source backdoor must be the proportion of triggered carrier examples predicted `BENIGN`.
- **REQ-0680 — §15.2 Source Copy — Robustness:** For a one-shot reproduction-based method, `Source Copy` must submit exactly the source update vector `a_s-w_a` and label that row Byzantine.
- **REQ-0681 — §15.2 Source Copy — Robustness:** For an ordinary multi-round FL/robust-aggregation method mapped to `Source Copy`, the compromised client must submit the exact committed source model each affected round, i.e. delta `a_s-w_current`.
- **REQ-0682 — §15.2 Source Copy — Robustness:** `Source Copy` must perform no local optimizer step for the copied update.
- **REQ-0683 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Robustness:** A reproduction-based `Model-Replacement Backdoor` must select 10% of the malicious domain's capped `Post-Reference Replay` `GAFGYT_UDP` rows by `Attack Generation` hash order.
- **REQ-0684 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Robustness:** Selected model-replacement carrier rows must be replaced by triggered `BENIGN`-relabeled copies while retaining all other legitimate target/supported rows.
- **REQ-0685 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Training:** Reproduction-based model replacement must train from the anchor for the standard 5 epochs.
- **REQ-0686 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Robustness:** The resulting full model-delta vector must be multiplied by 5.0 before commitment.
- **REQ-0687 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Robustness:** Clean originals of poisoned model-replacement rows must not be duplicated.
- **REQ-0688 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Failure Semantics:** If no eligible `GAFGYT_UDP` carrier exists or cardinality rounds to zero, the model-replacement attack must be `Evidence Insufficient`.
- **REQ-0689 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Robustness:** For multi-round ordinary FL/robust aggregation, the same poisoned view must be reused in every post-reference round.
- **REQ-0690 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor — Training:** A multi-round malicious client must start each round from that round's received global checkpoint, train exactly the method's ordinary 1 local epoch, then scale the round delta by 5.0.
- **REQ-0692 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Robustness:** `Verifier-Aware Backdoor` must use the same 10% `GAFGYT_UDP` carrier subset and `Attack Generation` ordering as model replacement.
- **REQ-0693 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Robustness:** Verifier-aware training must keep clean carrier originals in `L_legitimate` and create triggered `BENIGN` copies only for the auxiliary backdoor term.
- **REQ-0694 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** Verifier-aware reproduction must train from the anchor for exactly 10 epochs.
- **REQ-0695 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** Verifier-aware objective must be `L_legitimate + 2.0*L_triggered_backdoor`.
- **REQ-0696 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** `L_legitimate` must be the exact clean Section 12.4 reproduction objective including supported-stability regularization.
- **REQ-0697 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** `L_triggered_backdoor` must be mean cross-entropy on triggered auxiliary copies.
- **REQ-0698 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** At each optimizer step the auxiliary term must use triggered copies corresponding only to carrier rows present in that clean minibatch; if none are present, the term is 0.0.
- **REQ-0700 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Robustness:** Verifier-aware backdoor must not apply model-replacement scaling.
- **REQ-0701 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Training:** When an ordinary FL/robust-aggregation baseline explicitly names `Verifier-Aware Backdoor`, its local attack override remains 10 epochs even though this exceeds the common five-local-epoch budget.
- **REQ-0702 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor — Configuration:** Compromised reproducer counts tested must be exactly 0, 1, and 2, with declared primary bound 1.
- **REQ-0703 — §15.3 — Robustness:** Byzantine verifier `False Positive` mode must vote `Positive` on a malicious/failed row whenever called.
- **REQ-0704 — §15.3 — Robustness:** Byzantine verifier `False Negative` mode must vote `Negative` on an honest row whenever called.
- **REQ-0705 — §15.3 — Configuration:** Verifier compromise counts tested per 3-member panel must be exactly 0, 1, and 2; count 2 is explicitly above the declared primary bound.
- **REQ-0756 — §15.10 — Mathematics:** Every fraction-based transformation must use `m=floor(fraction*eligible_population_size)` unless an exact count is separately specified.
- **REQ-0757 — §15.10 — Failure Semantics:** For a positive transformation fraction with `m=0`, the cell must be `Evidence Insufficient`; the implementation must not force one transformed row.
- **REQ-0758 — §15.10 — Robustness:** Selected transformation rows must be the first `m` rows in `Attack Generation` hash order.
- **REQ-0759 — §15.10 — Robustness:** Shared-label-error, shared-spurious-feature, and attacker-induced-common-context fixtures must affect all honest non-source domains with structurally eligible rows in the transformed role.
- **REQ-0760 — §15.10 — Evaluation:** Corrupted operational roles are reproduction, row verification, and final admission; `Report Test` remains clean unless an experiment explicitly defines an oracle transformation.
- **REQ-0761 — §15.10 — Robustness:** Root-cause fixture membership must remain immutable across `Source Proposal`, `Candidate Screen`, `Reproduction`, `Row Verification`, `Final Gate`, and `Report Test`.
- **REQ-0762 — §15.10 — Preprocessing:** Root-cause feature shifts must be applied after fixed standardization and before model input.
- **REQ-0763 — §15.10 — Robustness:** `Balanced 50/50` must choose `k=min(n_A,n_B)` and select exactly `k` A plus `k` B rows by hash order.
- **REQ-0764 — §15.10 — Robustness:** `A-Dominant 80/20` must choose `k=min(floor(n_A/4),n_B)` and select exactly `4k` A plus `k` B rows by hash order.
- **REQ-0765 — §15.10 — Metric:** `false_same_capability_certification_rate` must be defined only for the broad contract.

- **REQ-0767 — §15.10 — Metric:** The false-same-capability denominator must be broad-contract certified rows; zero denominator must produce `NA`.
- **REQ-0768 — §15.10 — Metric:** Scoped contracts must report certified yield/root-cause performance but must not receive a synthetic false-equivalence rate.

- **REQ-0770 — §15.10 — Experiment:** The `Generic Hard Supported Examples` episode must provide no target rows to source adaptation and use each supported class's highest anchor-cross-entropy decile of source post-reference replay with true labels under the common budget while retaining the fixed `GAFGYT_COMBO` claim.
- **REQ-0771 — §15.10 — Experiment:** The `Irrelevant Source Improvement` episode must preselect the non-target/non-benign supported class with largest mean anchor-validation cross-entropy, breaking ties by ascending class ID, and adapt only on that class's source replay plus ordinary supported-stability replay while retaining the fixed target claim.
- **REQ-0772 — §15.10 — Experiment:** The `Useful Backdoored Source — 5%` proposal-collapse episode must use Section 15.1 exactly.
- **REQ-0774 — §15.10 — Metric:** For shared epistemic-failure experiments, clean-oracle degradation is material when at least one configured target-F1 decrease, supported-macro-F1 drop, or benign-FAR increase threshold is exceeded relative to the matched uncorrupted cell.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0691 — §15.2 Model-Replacement Backdoor:** A five-round post-reference FL baseline under model replacement must still use five malicious local epochs total; the attack must not multiply the budget beyond one epoch per round.
- **REQ-0699 — §15.2 Verifier-Aware Backdoor:** The verifier-aware attacker may know the verifier predicate but must not know realized verifier identities/samples before commitment.

# M05 — I28 Implement Epistemic-Failure and Capability-Granularity Boundary Transforms

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M05 — Adversarial Mechanisms and Baseline Suite
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement shared label-error, shared spurious-feature, attacker-induced common-context, and capability under-specification fixtures with fixed root-cause/cardinality semantics.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §15.4
- §15.5
- §15.6
- §15.7

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0706–REQ-0710; REQ-0712–REQ-0722; REQ-0724–REQ-0732
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0711; REQ-0723

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement shared label-error, shared spurious-feature, attacker-induced common-context, and capability under-specification fixtures with fixed root-cause/cardinality semantics.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0706 — §15.4 — Configuration:** Shared-label-error strengths must be exactly 5%, 10%, and 20%.
- **REQ-0707 — §15.4 — Robustness:** For each strength, select that fraction of `BENIGN` rows from supported reproduction replay, supported row-verification, and final-gate views in every affected honest non-source domain using `Attack Generation` hash order.
- **REQ-0708 — §15.4 — Robustness:** Selected shared-label-error rows must be relabeled `GAFGYT_COMBO` in the corrupted operational evidence oracle.
- **REQ-0709 — §15.4 — Evaluation:** Clean `Report Test` must retain benign truth under shared-label-error experiments.
- **REQ-0710 — §15.4 — Evaluation:** Evidence adequacy under shared label error must use labels visible to the corrupted operational oracle, so relabeled benign rows count as target evidence and no longer as supported-control evidence.
- **REQ-0712 — §15.5 — Configuration:** Shared-spurious-feature strengths must be exactly 25%, 50%, and 100%.
- **REQ-0713 — §15.5 — Robustness:** Shared-spurious-feature fixture must set standardized `MI_dir_L0.1_weight=+6.0` on the selected fraction of target Reproduction, Row Verification, and Final Gate rows across affected honest non-source domains.
- **REQ-0714 — §15.5 — Evaluation:** The shared spurious marker must be absent from clean target `Report Test` rows.
- **REQ-0715 — §15.5 — Robustness:** For each domain's diagnostic benign oracle, `m=floor(p*n_target_report)` must determine target report rows selected by `Attack Generation` hash order.
- **REQ-0716 — §15.5 — Algorithm:** Selected target-report anchor losses must be matched one-to-one without replacement to benign report-test rows using the Section 7.2 anchor-loss decile/nearest-loss procedure, type-7 deciles from the full benign report-test pool, and ascending sample-ID ties.
- **REQ-0717 — §15.5 — Failure Semantics:** If complete benign matching is impossible, the diagnostic marker metric must be `NA` with reason `Insufficient Matched Benign Report-Test Controls` while operational protocol outcome remains valid.
- **REQ-0718 — §15.5 — Evaluation:** The marker must be applied only to matched benign diagnostic copies; stored clean report-test data must remain immutable.
- **REQ-0719 — §15.6 — Configuration:** Attacker-induced common-context strengths must be exactly 25%, 50%, and 100%.
- **REQ-0720 — §15.6 — Robustness:** The common-context fixture must apply the full four-feature trigger to the selected fraction of target Reproduction, Row Verification, and Final Gate evidence across honest non-source domains without changing labels.
- **REQ-0721 — §15.6 — Evaluation:** Triggered benign report-test diagnostics must use the exact Section 15.5 cardinality/matching rule and receive the full four-feature trigger.
- **REQ-0722 — §15.6 — Evaluation:** Clean report-test rows must remain immutable and be scored separately from common-context diagnostic copies.
- **REQ-0724 — §15.7 — Robustness:** Root Cause A membership must be hash parity 0 of `SHA256(canonical_bytes('CAPABILITY_ROOT_CAUSE',sample_id))[0:8]` interpreted big-endian modulo 2; Root Cause B must be parity 1.
- **REQ-0725 — §15.7 — Robustness:** Root Cause A must receive a +3.0 standardized shift to `MI_dir_L0.1_weight`; Root Cause B must receive +3.0 to `HpHp_L0.1_mean`.
- **REQ-0726 — §15.7 — Robustness:** Root-cause markers must be applied consistently to corresponding strata in every post-reference claim-bearing role.
- **REQ-0727 — §15.7 — Algorithm:** The `Broad Target Only` contract must treat both root causes as in-scope target rows.
- **REQ-0728 — §15.7 — Algorithm:** The `Root-Cause A Scoped` contract must include only A rows as target and exclude B rows from target training/evidence/verification/final-gate pools rather than relabel them supported.
- **REQ-0729 — §15.7 — Algorithm:** The `Root-Cause B Scoped` contract must include only B rows as target and exclude A rows analogously.
- **REQ-0730 — §15.7 — Dataset:** Supported classes must remain the ten non-target labels for all three root-cause contracts.
- **REQ-0731 — §15.7 — Evaluation:** Evidence minima must apply to the in-scope target stratum after mixture construction.
- **REQ-0732 — §15.7 — Evaluation:** The excluded opposite root cause may appear only in separate diagnostic root-cause report-test metrics and must never become a supported-control class.

# M05 — I29 Implement Evidence-Arrival and Honest-Heterogeneity Stress Transforms

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M05 — Adversarial Mechanisms and Baseline Suite
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement fixed evidence-arrival schedules, natural/quantity-skew/feature-shift heterogeneity regimes, deterministic transformation identities, controlled-episode completion rules, and stress manifests.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §15.8
- §15.9
- §15.10

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0733–REQ-0755
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0773

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement fixed evidence-arrival schedules, natural/quantity-skew/feature-shift heterogeneity regimes, deterministic transformation identities, controlled-episode completion rules, and stress manifests.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0733 — §15.8 — Configuration:** Evidence-arrival measurement cycles must be integers 0 through 12 while resource expiry remains cycle 30.
- **REQ-0734 — §15.8 — Robustness:** `Permanent Singleton` must expose 0 eligible non-source target-evidence holders at every cycle.
- **REQ-0735 — §15.8 — Robustness:** `One Honest Holder` must expose 0 holders at cycle 0 and 1 holder from cycle 2 onward.
- **REQ-0736 — §15.8 — Robustness:** `Gradual to Quorum` must expose 0 holders at cycle 0, 1 at cycle 2, 3 at cycle 4, 5 at cycle 6, and 8 at cycle 8.
- **REQ-0737 — §15.8 — Robustness:** `Immediate Quorum` must expose all eligible non-source target-evidence holders at cycle 0.
- **REQ-0738 — §15.8 — Algorithm:** At each schedule/cycle, holders must be the first `k` structurally target-capable non-source domains in fixed `Reproducer Order`, and the holder set must grow monotonically.
- **REQ-0739 — §15.8 — Preprocessing:** When a domain becomes a holder, its target Candidate Screen, Reproduction, Row Verification, and Final Gate roles must become available from that cycle onward.
- **REQ-0740 — §15.8 — Preprocessing:** Supported roles must be available from cycle 0.
- **REQ-0741 — §15.8 — Preprocessing:** The source `Source Proposal` role must be available from cycle 0.
- **REQ-0742 — §15.8 — Evaluation:** `Report Test` must remain an offline clean oracle and must not be gated by logical evidence cycles.
- **REQ-0743 — §15.8 — Metric:** `T_reproduction_evidence` must be the first cycle when the resolved reproduction-row requirement is possible in principle, including verifier-panel feasibility where required.
- **REQ-0744 — §15.8 — Metric:** `T_evidence` must be the first cycle when all non-source evidence needed for possible terminal admission is available, including opening, reproduction/verifier, and six-domain final-gate requirements.
- **REQ-0745 — §15.8 — Mathematics:** For the five-row full Krum path under `Gradual to Quorum`, `T_reproduction_evidence` must be 6 and `T_evidence` 8; under `Immediate Quorum`, both must be 0.
- **REQ-0746 — §15.8 — Metric:** Schedules that never satisfy method-specific evidence requirements must report `NA/∞` and must not enter a finite wall-clock total.
- **REQ-0747 — §15.9 — Robustness:** `Natural` heterogeneity must apply no additional transformation.
- **REQ-0748 — §15.9 — Robustness:** `Quantity Skew` must assign multipliers exactly `(1.00,0.90,0.80,0.70,0.60,0.50,0.40,0.30,0.20)` to all nine domains by ascending Heterogeneity-namespace hash order over fixed domain tokens.
- **REQ-0749 — §15.9 — Robustness:** Quantity-skew assignment is done once for all nine domains; source exclusion must remove the source's already-assigned multiplier without reindexing remaining domains.
- **REQ-0750 — §15.9 — Preprocessing:** Quantity skew must multiply each applicable post-reference target and supported cap by the domain multiplier and round down to integer; evidence minima remain binding.
- **REQ-0751 — §15.9 — Robustness:** Feature-shift regimes must select the first 10 feature names by the specified `HETEROGENEITY_FEATURE_ORDER` SHA-256 order with feature-name tie-break.
- **REQ-0752 — §15.9 — Robustness:** For each selected `(domain,feature)`, feature-shift sign must derive from `HETEROGENEITY_FEATURE_SIGN` hash and use + when the last digest byte low bit is 1, otherwise -.
- **REQ-0753 — §15.9 — Robustness:** `Feature Shift ±0.5` must add the derived ±0.5 standardized shift to all post-reference roles of each domain for the selected features.
- **REQ-0754 — §15.9 — Robustness:** `Feature Shift ±1.0` must apply the same rule with ±1.0.
- **REQ-0755 — §15.9 — Training:** Heterogeneity stress transformations must not alter anchor training.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

These constraints create no separate implementation work, but this issue must not violate them:

- **REQ-0773 — §15.10:** Negative proposal episodes must be deterministic and must not select a new target after observing the source model.

## Out of Scope

# M05 — I30 Implement Core Baselines and Comparator Fairness Contracts

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M05 — Adversarial Mechanisms and Baseline Suite
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement the baseline registry common budgets/information rules and the core/simple comparators, including local-only, centralized, FedAvg, review/retrain, candidate-free, direct-Krum, and coordinate-median alternatives under matched fairness.
- **Issue type:** Implementation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §16
- §16.1
- §16.2 `Local-Only Reference`
- §16.2 `Centralized Reference`
- §16.2 `FedAvg Reference`
- §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission`
- §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain`
- §16.2 `One Independent Retrain`
- §16.2 `Candidate-Free Full Path`
- §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum`
- §16.2 `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative`
- §16.4

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-0775–REQ-0777; REQ-0779–REQ-0794; REQ-0831; REQ-0833; REQ-2112–REQ-2150
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** REQ-0778; REQ-0832; REQ-1942; REQ-2151

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement the baseline registry common budgets/information rules and the core/simple comparators, including local-only, centralized, FedAvg, review/retrain, candidate-free, direct-Krum, and coordinate-median alternatives under matched fairness.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0775 — §16 — Configuration:** `baselines.*` may contain only baseline-specific numerical budgets, thresholds, and counts; baseline identities, mechanisms, shared-budget derivations, distance/quantile procedures, review semantics, and fixture map must be fixed by Section 16.
- **REQ-0776 — §16 — Comparator:** Every baseline must use the same preprocessing, domain mapping, anchor checkpoint, model architecture, seed pairing, report-test populations, and primary metrics unless its mechanism explicitly requires a documented difference.
- **REQ-0777 — §16 — Comparator:** No baseline may use `Report Test` or `Final Gate` rows for tuning.
- **REQ-0779 — §16.1 — Comparator:** Standard FL baselines must run 20 rounds with 1 local epoch/round and full participation where their mechanism permits.
- **REQ-0780 — §16.1 — Comparator:** A post-reference one-retrain/recovery step may use at most 5 local epochs per participating domain unless an explicit baseline contract states otherwise.
- **REQ-0781 — §16.1 — Evaluation:** FedSIRA's additional reproduction/verification compute and communication must be measured rather than hidden in baseline budgeting.
- **REQ-0782 — §16.1 — Comparator:** Baselines must not receive extra target labels, post-reference windows, tuning seeds, or source-private data beyond their declared mechanism.
- **REQ-0783 — §16.1 — Comparator:** Baseline thresholds must be fixed from anchor-validation or other explicitly pre-execution data only.
- **REQ-0784 — §16.1 — Comparator:** For ordinary post-reference FL baselines, the source target view must be capped `Source Proposal`; each non-source target view must be capped `Reproduction`; all domains use capped `Post-Reference Replay` supported rows unless a stricter contract applies.
- **REQ-0785 — §16.1 — Comparator:** A domain with no target view may participate with supported replay only when the baseline contract allows full participation.
- **REQ-0786 — §16.2 `Local-Only Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Local-Only Reference` as the no-sharing reference.
- **REQ-2112 — §16.2 `Local-Only Reference` — Comparator:** Each domain must train the base MLP for exactly 20 epochs for the `Local-Only Reference`.
- **REQ-2113 — §16.2 `Local-Only Reference` — Comparator:** Each `Local-Only Reference` domain may train only on its own supported `Anchor Train` data.
- **REQ-2114 — §16.2 `Local-Only Reference` — Comparator:** The `Local-Only Reference` must perform no federation.
- **REQ-2115 — §16.2 `Local-Only Reference` — Comparator:** The final local checkpoint for `Local-Only Reference` must be evaluated only on that same domain's report population.
- **REQ-0787 — §16.2 `Centralized Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Centralized Reference` as a centralized context upper/reference control, not a security equivalent.
- **REQ-2116 — §16.2 `Centralized Reference` — Comparator:** The `Centralized Reference` must centrally pool the same capped anchor-training rows used by the shared protocol.
- **REQ-2117 — §16.2 `Centralized Reference` — Comparator:** The `Centralized Reference` must train the same base MLP for exactly 20 epochs.
- **REQ-2118 — §16.2 `Centralized Reference` — Comparator:** The `Centralized Reference` must use AdamW with batch size 256 under the common optimizer contract.
- **REQ-2119 — §16.2 `Centralized Reference` — Comparator:** The `Centralized Reference` must evaluate using the identical report roles used by the common protocol.
- **REQ-0788 — §16.2 `FedAvg Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `FedAvg Reference` as the standard collaborative-learning control.
- **REQ-2120 — §16.2 `FedAvg Reference` — Comparator:** The `FedAvg Reference` anchor phase must be the exact Section 12.3 20-round anchor FedAvg protocol.
- **REQ-2121 — §16.2 `FedAvg Reference` — Comparator:** Post-reference `FedAvg Reference` adaptation must run exactly 5 communication rounds.
- **REQ-2122 — §16.2 `FedAvg Reference` — Comparator:** Each eligible domain must train exactly 1 local epoch in each post-reference `FedAvg Reference` round.
- **REQ-2123 — §16.2 `FedAvg Reference` — Comparator:** Post-reference `FedAvg Reference` must include the source domain when the scenario makes the source available.
- **REQ-0789 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` as the source-controlled review-and-direct-deployment comparator.
- **REQ-2124 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** The source must train the candidate under the fixed source-candidate training contract before review.
- **REQ-2125 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** Exactly 3 non-source reviewers must be assigned after the source commitment exists.
- **REQ-2126 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** Each reviewer must evaluate the fixed Capability Claim Contract on the composite screen view: target `Candidate Screen` plus supported `Post-Reference Replay` rows.
- **REQ-2127 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** The source artifact must be admitted directly only when at least 2 of the 3 reviewers are positive.
- **REQ-2128 — §16.2 `Client Review with Direct Source Admission` — Comparator:** When admitted by this baseline, the production model must be the source candidate itself.
- **REQ-0790 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` as the predeclared review→single-clean-retrain composition.
- **REQ-2129 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** This baseline must first execute `Client Review with Direct Source Admission`.
- **REQ-2130 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** If source review passes, the source weights must be discarded as training input for the independent retrain.
- **REQ-2131 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The independent retrain must use the first eligible non-source reproducer in the precommitted order.
- **REQ-2132 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The selected non-source reproducer must train one clean reproduction for exactly 5 local epochs.
- **REQ-2133 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The resulting reproduction must pass one fresh verifier before production.
- **REQ-2134 — §16.2 `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The production model for this baseline must be that independently trained reproduction, not the source model.
- **REQ-0791 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `One Independent Retrain` as the minimum constructive single-reproduction alternative.
- **REQ-2135 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The `One Independent Retrain` baseline must perform no source review.
- **REQ-2136 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** It must select the first eligible non-source reproducer in the fixed precommitted order.
- **REQ-2137 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** It must train exactly one clean reproduction under the common 5-local-epoch post-reference budget.
- **REQ-2138 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The reproduction must be evaluated by one fresh non-source verifier.
- **REQ-2139 — §16.2 `One Independent Retrain` — Comparator:** The production model must be that reproduction only when the fresh verifier passes.
- **REQ-0792 — §16.2 `Candidate-Free Full Path` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Candidate-Free Full Path` as the complete FedSIRA downstream path with only claim opening changed.
- **REQ-2140 — §16.2 `Candidate-Free Full Path` — Comparator:** The `Candidate-Free Full Path` must open the claim from confirmed anchor target failure without reading a source model.
- **REQ-2141 — §16.2 `Candidate-Free Full Path` — Comparator:** After opening, it must execute the exact FedSIRA reproduction, verifier, five-row certificate, Krum synthesis, and final-gate path.
- **REQ-2142 — §16.2 `Candidate-Free Full Path` — Comparator:** Claim opening must be the only mechanism difference between `Candidate-Free Full Path` and the complete FedSIRA path.
- **REQ-0793 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` to isolate the value of external reproduction verification.
- **REQ-2143 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** This comparator must generate the same candidate reproduction rows and deterministic five-row committee opportunity as FedSIRA.
- **REQ-2144 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** This comparator must not externally certify reproduction rows.
- **REQ-2145 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** Krum may run only after the first five non-abstaining committed reproduction rows exist.
- **REQ-2146 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** This comparator must use the exact Section 7.6 Krum operator.
- **REQ-2147 — §16.2 `Multiple Retrains with Direct Krum` — Comparator:** The Krum-produced model must pass the standard final fresh gate.
- **REQ-0794 — §16.2 `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative` as a distinct generic-`2f+1` diagnostic operator, never as a Krum variant.
- **REQ-2148 — §16.2 `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative` — Comparator:** The coordinate-median diagnostic must use exactly 3 reproduction rows.
- **REQ-2149 — §16.2 `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative` — Comparator:** The coordinate-median diagnostic must use assumed Byzantine count `f=1`.
- **REQ-2150 — §16.2 `Three-Row Coordinate-Median Alternative` — Comparator:** Its synthesis output must be the coordinate-wise median of the three reproduction rows.
- **REQ-0831 — §16.4 — Comparator:** Every comparator must use the predeclared information access, architecture, budget, calibration evidence, source-artifact access, aggregation/synthesis rule, and evaluation roles defined by Section 16.
- **REQ-0833 — §16.4 — Failure Semantics:** A technically incompatible baseline must remain `Invalid` and must never be silently replaced after outcomes are visible.

## Non-Negotiable Implementation Contracts

The implementation must preserve exactly, where defined by the roadmap:

- roadmap-defined algorithmic semantics;
- formulas, thresholds, equality semantics, tolerances, and numerical conventions;
- configuration authority and ownership;
- dataset, split, eligibility, chronology, and preprocessing semantics;
- experiment coordinates, controls, comparators, seeds, and statistical procedures;
- deterministic and reproducibility requirements;
- failure, unavailable, infeasible, insufficient-evidence, suppression, and abstention semantics;
- artifact, integrity, completion, and provenance requirements;
- scientific claim boundaries.

Do not introduce:

- undocumented defaults;
- hidden fallbacks;
- alternative algorithms or scientific behavior;
- post-hoc scientific choices;
- duplicated scientific constants;
- silent compatibility behavior;
- agent-invented values or assumptions.

If the roadmap is genuinely missing or contradictory on a decision that materially affects scientific or implementation behavior, do not guess. Record it under **Roadmap Deviations / Follow-Ups** and create a dedicated clarification or correction issue.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-0795 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` as the FLCert-style multiple-model ensemble representative.
- **REQ-2152 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** The nine domains must be partitioned into 3 deterministic disjoint groups of 3 using `Domain Partition`.
- **REQ-2153 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** Exactly one 20-round FedAvg model must be trained per deterministic group, with all members of that group participating.
- **REQ-2154 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** Ensemble inference must first use majority vote over the three model argmax class predictions.
- **REQ-2155 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** When all three ensemble argmax labels differ, the tie must be resolved by the arithmetic mean of the three softmax probabilities for those three tied labels.
- **REQ-2156 — §16.3 `Multiple-Model Certified Ensemble` — Comparator:** Any remaining exact ensemble tie after mean-softmax comparison must be broken by the lowest class index.
- **REQ-0796 — §16.3 `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` as the SureFED-style local-reference trust-evidence representative.
- **REQ-2157 — §16.3 `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` — Comparator:** Each reviewer must train a local reference model for exactly 20 epochs on its own anchor data.
- **REQ-2158 — §16.3 `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` — Comparator:** After source commitment, exactly 3 reviewers must compare source-candidate behavior against their clean local-reference behavior on the composite screen view.
- **REQ-2159 — §16.3 `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` — Comparator:** A reviewer may vote positive only when the source candidate satisfies the fixed target/support Capability Claim Contract and does not exceed the local-reference supported-harm constraint.
- **REQ-2160 — §16.3 `Independent Local Reference with Source Admission` — Comparator:** Exactly 2 of 3 positive reviewer votes must admit the source artifact in this baseline.
- **REQ-0797 — §16.3 `Update Reconstruction Filter` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Update Reconstruction Filter` as the FedREDefense-style update-reconstruction filtering representative.
- **REQ-2161 — §16.3 `Update Reconstruction Filter` — Comparator:** Every standard-FL submitted client update must have a plausible update reconstructed by one local epoch on the domain's capped `Anchor Validation` rows.
- **REQ-2162 — §16.3 `Update Reconstruction Filter` — Comparator:** Reconstruction error must be squared L2 distance between submitted and reconstructed updates divided by submitted-update squared norm plus `1e-12`.
- **REQ-0798 — §16.3 `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` as the FedDBC-style IoT collusion-defense representative.
- **REQ-2163 — §16.3 `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` — Comparator:** Submitted update vectors must be L2-normalized before density clustering.
- **REQ-2164 — §16.3 `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` — Comparator:** Pairwise cosine distances must be computed from the submitted updates before DBSCAN.
- **REQ-2165 — §16.3 `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` — Comparator:** For a selected cluster of size at least 3, aggregation must use the raw updates and remove exactly one largest and one smallest coordinate value before averaging each coordinate.
- **REQ-2166 — §16.3 `Density-Cluster Trimmed Mean` — Comparator:** For a selected cluster of size below 3, aggregation must use the arithmetic mean of the selected raw updates.
- **REQ-0799 — §16.3 `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` as the assess-then-continue-learning representative.
- **REQ-2167 — §16.3 `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` — Comparator:** Confirmed anchor target failure must trigger a 3-reviewer benign-task assessment of the committed source candidate.
- **REQ-2168 — §16.3 `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` — Comparator:** Exactly 2 of 3 positive reviewers must authorize the 5-round post-reference continuation.
- **REQ-2169 — §16.3 `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` — Comparator:** Authorized continuation must run over all eligible domains, including the source.
- **REQ-2170 — §16.3 `Secure Continual Assessment Reference` — Comparator:** The resulting post-reference FedAvg model must be the production model for this comparator.
- **REQ-0800 — §16.3 `Recovery after Source Admission` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Recovery after Source Admission` as the post-source-influence repair comparator.
- **REQ-2171 — §16.3 `Recovery after Source Admission` — Comparator:** The recovery comparator must first admit the source artifact via `Client Review with Direct Source Admission`.
- **REQ-2172 — §16.3 `Recovery after Source Admission` — Comparator:** After source admission, the recovery comparator must evaluate the fresh `Row Verification` window before deciding whether to roll back.
- **REQ-0801 — §16.3 `Source-Update Sanitization Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Source-Update Sanitization Reference` as the useful-source-information sanitization comparator.
- **REQ-2173 — §16.3 `Source-Update Sanitization Reference` — Comparator:** The source update must be clipped coordinate-wise to the pre-calibrated per-coordinate absolute bounds.
- **REQ-2174 — §16.3 `Source-Update Sanitization Reference` — Comparator:** The clipped source update must be applied to the anchor to form the candidate model.
- **REQ-2175 — §16.3 `Source-Update Sanitization Reference` — Comparator:** The clipped candidate must receive 2-of-3 client review before production.
- **REQ-0802 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** The baseline registry must include `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` as the ordinary round-level Krum comparator without capability-specific external reproduction verification.
- **REQ-2176 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** The `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` must use Krum with `(n=5,f=1)` and the same score/tie semantics as FedSIRA.
- **REQ-2177 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Post-reference adaptation must run exactly 5 communication rounds with exactly 1 local epoch per selected participant per round.
- **REQ-2178 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** The five round participants must be determined before any local training begins in that round.
- **REQ-2179 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** In a clean condition, participants must be the first five post-reference-eligible domains in `Client Sampling` hash order for `(master_seed, round_index)`.
- **REQ-2180 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** In a condition with a designated compromised ordinary-FL participant, that preselected compromised domain must be included and the other four positions filled by the first eligible uncompromised domains in the same order.
- **REQ-2181 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Forced compromised-participant inclusion must depend only on the declared attack condition and must never use outcome metrics.
- **REQ-2182 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Every selected participant must start from the current global model and train exactly one local epoch under the common post-reference data contract.
- **REQ-2183 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Any declared malicious round-update transformation must be applied after local training and before Krum submission.
- **REQ-2184 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Krum must run on exactly the five submitted round deltas.
- **REQ-2185 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** The next global model must equal `current_global + krum_selected_delta`.
- **REQ-2186 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** Participant selection must be recomputed deterministically for each round from that round index.
- **REQ-2187 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Failure Semantics:** If fewer than five eligible domains exist for a round, the cell must be `Evidence Insufficient`.
- **REQ-2188 — §16.3 `Krum Robust Aggregation Reference` — Comparator:** The final round-5 checkpoint must be the production object evaluated by the experiment.
- **REQ-0803 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** Every 3-reviewer baseline must use the post-commitment adequate-reviewer order derived from `Verifier Assignment`.
- **REQ-2189 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** Every 3-reviewer baseline must exclude the source from its reviewer set.
- **REQ-2190 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** Every 3-reviewer baseline must require exactly 2 positive reports for acceptance/authorization.
- **REQ-2191 — §16.5 Review-style — Failure Semantics:** A 3-reviewer baseline with fewer than 3 adequate reviewers must produce `Dormant`.
- **REQ-2192 — §16.5 Review-style — Failure Semantics:** A 3-reviewer baseline with three adequate reviewers but fewer than 2 positive reports must produce `Rejected Claim`.
- **REQ-0804 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** For `Client Review then One Independent Retrain` and `One Independent Retrain`, the single fresh verifier must be the first adequate eligible domain in post-commitment `Verifier Assignment` order, excluding source and reproducer.
- **REQ-2193 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** For the single fresh verifier used by the one-retrain baselines, a `Positive` report must admit the reproduction.
- **REQ-2194 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** For the single fresh verifier used by the one-retrain baselines, a `Negative` report must reject that reproduction row.
- **REQ-2195 — §16.5 Review-style — Failure Semantics:** If no adequate eligible single fresh verifier exists after scanning the fixed order, the one-retrain baseline result must be `Dormant`.
- **REQ-0805 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** Independent Local Reference reviewer positivity additionally requires source supported macro-F1 no more than 0.02 below the reviewer's local reference and benign FAR no more than 0.01 above it.
- **REQ-0806 — §16.5 Review-style — Comparator:** Secure Continual Assessment must use the same 3-reviewer source-candidate Capability Claim Contract assessment before its 5-round continuation.
- **REQ-0807 — §16.5 Ensemble — Comparator:** The ensemble group count must come from `baselines.multiple_model_certified_ensemble_group_count`; group size must be derived from the validated nine-domain primary population and group membership from `Domain Partition`.
- **REQ-0808 — §16.5 Ensemble — Comparator:** Ensemble post-reference adaptation must be exactly 5 FedAvg rounds ×1 local epoch per group; groups without a target-bearing member use supported-only data and must not synthesize target rows.
- **REQ-0809 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** Reconstruction filter must use all capped `Anchor Validation` rows for each domain's one-epoch reconstruction; there is no hidden subset size.
- **REQ-0810 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** For round `r`, reconstruction must start from the same round-start global checkpoint as the submitted client delta and use a fresh optimizer under the ordinary anchor optimizer contract.
- **REQ-0811 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** Known-honest reconstruction calibration must include every client update in every one of 20 anchor rounds, yielding 180 calibration errors when all nine domains are present.
- **REQ-0812 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** Reconstruction rejection percentile must come from `baselines.reconstruction_filter.calibration_percentile` and use type-7 quantiles.
- **REQ-2104 — §16.3 `Update Reconstruction Filter` — Comparator:** The reconstruction-error rejection threshold must be fixed once from known-honest calibration before confirmatory attack execution and must never be recalculated from attack or test outcomes.
- **REQ-0813 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** Accepted reconstruction-filter updates must be sample-count reweighted over the accepted set only.
- **REQ-0814 — §16.5 Reconstruction — Comparator:** If every update is rejected in a post-reference round, the global model must remain unchanged and the no-op must be recorded.
- **REQ-0815 — §16.5 Density — Comparator:** Density clustering must call DBSCAN with `metric='precomputed'` on the explicit cosine-distance matrix, `eps=0.25`, `min_samples=2`, and no sample weights.
- **REQ-0816 — §16.5 Density — Comparator:** Cosine distance must be `1-cos(u,v)` for nonzero vectors, 0 when both are exactly zero, and 1 when exactly one is zero.
- **REQ-0817 — §16.5 Density — Comparator:** Non-noise clusters must be canonicalized by lexicographically sorted member-domain tuples.
- **REQ-0818 — §16.5 Density — Comparator:** Largest-cluster ties must use lowest mean within-cluster cosine distance then lexicographically smallest member tuple.
- **REQ-0819 — §16.5 Density — Comparator:** If DBSCAN finds no non-noise cluster, the round must be a recorded no-op with no fallback aggregation over noise/rejected updates.
- **REQ-0820 — §16.5 Recovery — Comparator:** Recovery baseline backdoor alarm must be calibrated before confirmatory attack execution on fixed-anchor triggered `GAFGYT_UDP` `Anchor Validation` rows.
- **REQ-0821 — §16.5 Recovery — Comparator:** Per-domain triggered-to-`BENIGN` rates must determine a type-7 95th-percentile alarm threshold.
- **REQ-0822 — §16.5 Recovery — Comparator:** Fresh Row Verification must trigger rollback when supported macro-F1 drop exceeds 0.02, benign FAR increase exceeds 0.01, or triggered-to-BENIGN rate exceeds the fixed threshold.
- **REQ-0823 — §16.5 Recovery — Comparator:** Recovery rollback detection must not use target-F1 as a trigger.
- **REQ-0824 — §16.5 Recovery — Comparator:** Recovery must run exactly 5 FedAvg rounds ×1 local epoch on eligible non-source reproduction data followed by the standard final gate.
- **REQ-0825 — §16.5 Sanitization — Comparator:** Source-update clipping bounds must be calibrated from the same derived 180 honest anchor-round updates using coordinate-wise type-7 95th percentiles of absolute magnitude.
- **REQ-0826 — §16.5 Sanitization — Comparator:** Source-update reviewers must evaluate the clipped candidate `anchor+clipped_source_delta`, not the unclipped source model.
- **REQ-0827 — §16.5 Parameter Similarity — Comparator:** `Parameter-Similarity Certification` must operate only after five committed non-source reproduction rows exist.
- **REQ-2196 — §16.5 Parameter Similarity — Comparator:** For each of five committed non-source rows, parameter-similarity certification must compare that row's cosine similarity with the arithmetic mean of the other four rows.
- **REQ-2197 — §16.5 Parameter Similarity — Comparator:** If either vector in a parameter-similarity comparison has zero L2 norm, similarity must be `NA` and that row must not be certified.
- **REQ-2198 — §16.5 Parameter Similarity — Comparator:** A nonzero-norm row must be parameter-similarity certified only when cosine similarity is at least `0.90`.
- **REQ-2199 — §16.5 Parameter Similarity — Comparator:** No parameter-similarity certification attempt may run with fewer than five committed rows.
- **REQ-0828 — §16.5 Same Context — Ablation:** Same-context verifier ablation must compute anchor-train standardized feature-mean vectors and choose the three adequate eligible verifiers with smallest Euclidean distance to the reproducer, breaking ties by ascending domain ID.
- **REQ-0829 — §16.5 Source Release — Ablation:** `Source-release-after-certificate` must treat the source artifact itself as the candidate under one ordinary 3-member external verifier panel.
- **REQ-2200 — §16.5 Source Release — Ablation:** After the source candidate's ordinary external verifier panel, `Source-release-after-certificate` must apply the standard final gate.
- **REQ-2201 — §16.5 Source Release — Ablation:** The source-release ablation must not manufacture five independent source rows.
- **REQ-0830 — §16.5 Fixture map — Comparator:** Baseline validation must use exactly one predeclared fixture per baseline according to the Section 16.5 family map and must never choose fixtures based on observed performance.

## Non-Negotiable Implementation Contracts

The implementation must preserve exactly, where defined by the roadmap:

- roadmap-defined algorithmic semantics;
- formulas, thresholds, equality semantics, tolerances, and numerical conventions;
- configuration authority and ownership;
- dataset, split, eligibility, chronology, and preprocessing semantics;
- experiment coordinates, controls, comparators, seeds, and statistical procedures;
- deterministic and reproducibility requirements;
- failure, unavailable, infeasible, insufficient-evidence, suppression, and abstention semantics;
- artifact, integrity, completion, and provenance requirements;
- scientific claim boundaries.

Do not introduce:

- undocumented defaults;
- hidden fallbacks;
- alternative algorithms or scientific behavior;
- post-hoc scientific choices;
- duplicated scientific constants;
- silent compatibility behavior;
- agent-invented values or assumptions.

If the roadmap is genuinely missing or contradictory on a decision that materially affects scientific or implementation behavior, do not guess. Record it under **Roadmap Deviations / Follow-Ups** and create a dedicated clarification or correction issue.

# M05 — I32 Execute Baseline Implementation Validation

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M05 — Adversarial Mechanisms and Baseline Suite
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement and execute the exact seventeen-cell `Baseline Implementation Validation` at engineering seed 900001, preserving invalid/incompatible outcomes as scientific evidence.
- **Issue type:** Validation

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §30.3

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1790–REQ-1792
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement and execute the exact seventeen-cell `Baseline Implementation Validation` at engineering seed 900001, preserving invalid/incompatible outcomes as scientific evidence.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1790 — §30.3 — Experiment:** `Baseline Implementation Validation` must be class `Validation` with exactly 17 baseline validation cells, one per Section 16 baseline.
- **REQ-1791 — §30.3 — Experiment:** Baseline validation must use the fixed engineering seed 900001 and must not enter confirmatory inference.
- **REQ-1792 — §30.3 — Comparator:** Each baseline validation cell must execute its predeclared benign/adversarial fixture, produce finite model/output and common metrics, execute the expected mechanism path, and avoid test-role tuning.

### Preserved Non-Implementation Constraints

- None assigned to this issue.
