# M08 — I51 Generate Mandatory Manuscript Tables from Verified Evidence

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M08 — Claims, Reporting, and Reproducibility Closure
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement every required protocol/result/statistical/claim table with exact schema, ordering, aggregation, rounding, and machine-readable source lineage.
- **Issue type:** Reporting

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §33
- §33.1–33.2
- §33.2 Primary Results
- §33.2 Source-Exclusion Results
- §33.3

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1947–REQ-1969; REQ-2205
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement every required protocol/result/statistical/claim table with exact schema, ordering, aggregation, rounding, and machine-readable source lineage.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1947 — §33 — Reporting:** Every final manuscript table must be generated by `fedsira report` from verified machine-readable result/statistical data; scientific values must never be manually transcribed.
- **REQ-1948 — §33 — Reporting:** Experiment-owned tables must be exported under the experiment `tables/main\|supplementary` subtree and cross-experiment tables under project-summary table subtrees.
- **REQ-1949 — §33 — Reporting:** Exact filenames/rendering formats may be implementation choices, but every named table's mandatory content must be present.
- **REQ-1950 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Dataset and Domain Protocol` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows N-BaIoT then CICIoT2023; columns dataset, source identifier, file-manifest hash, raw rows, retained feature count, canonical class count, target class, domain-proxy count, proxy semantics, target holders, evidence-minimum rule, split/replay semantics, primary/secondary role.
- **REQ-1951 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Primary Domain Statistics` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows the nine primary proxies in Section 9.2 order; columns domain ID, device type, target availability, each target-role count, supported-role counts, reproduction/verifier/final-gate eligibility, report-test rows.
- **REQ-1952 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Model and Training Protocol` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows anchor, source candidate, honest reproduction; columns architecture, initialization, loss, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, epochs/rounds, regularizers, data roles, checkpoint rule, gradient clip.
- **REQ-1953 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Security and Capability-Contract Protocol` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows deterministic verifier, random diagnostic verifier, Krum synthesis, final gate; columns profile, f_R, f_V, panel size, positive threshold, certified-row requirement, Krum n, nearest-neighbor count, target threshold, supported-F1 margin, benign-FPR margin, evidence minimum, scope.
- **REQ-1954 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Baseline Protocol` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows all 17 Section 16 baselines; columns method, mechanism family, source artifact deployed yes/no, independent retraining count, external verification yes/no, aggregation/synthesis, training budget, tuning data, production object, implementation status.
- **REQ-1955 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Experiment Plan` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: one row per descriptive experiment in Section 30 order; columns name, class, methods, scenarios/variants, seeds, nominal count, primary metrics, claim family, prerequisite, downstream role.
- **REQ-1956 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Metric and Statistics Protocol` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: one row per claim-bearing metric/comparison family; columns metric, orientation, aggregation unit, undefined rule, primary/secondary role, effect threshold, test, sidedness, alpha, multiplicity family, CI method.
- **REQ-1957 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Primary Results` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows method×primary scenario; columns method, scenario, target F1 mean, target F1 95% CI, supported harm, benign FAR increase, ASR where defined, MAR, LAR, worst-domain target F1, complete-seed count.
- **REQ-1958 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Source-Exclusion Results` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows six source-exclusion methods; columns ASR, ASR difference vs FedSIRA, adjusted p, 95% CI, target F1, target non-inferiority pass, supported harm, benign-FPR/FAR increase, gate outcome.
- **REQ-1959 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Collapse Decisions` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows proposal assistance, plurality, direct source exclusion, external verification; columns mechanism, comparator, primary material effect, adjusted p, liveness/safety constraint, survival rule, observed outcome, core action; no manual narrative override field.
- **REQ-1960 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Ablation Results` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows all 18 variants in Section 30.10 order; columns variant, targeted mechanism, scenario, primary metric, difference from full reference, adjusted p, materiality pass, target F1, supported harm, relevant ASR/MAR, interpretation.
- **REQ-1961 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Byzantine Robustness` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows method×reproducer condition and verifier-profile×verifier condition; columns bound status, compromised count, strategy, MAR, LAR, ASR, target F1, certified yield, dormant rate, complete seeds; within-bound before above-bound then count ascending.
- **REQ-1962 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Failure Boundaries` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows scarcity schedule, epistemic type/strength, under-spec condition, heterogeneity regime; columns boundary family, condition, strength, admission/dormancy, target F1, worst-domain F1, claim implication, plus clean_oracle_error only for shared epistemic failure else NA reason.
- **REQ-1963 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Delay and Efficiency` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows method×schedule for delay and method for efficiency; columns T_evidence, assignment, reproduction, verification, synthesis, post-evidence overhead, wall-clock, GPU time, peak GPU memory, host RSS, communication bytes, transmissions, storage; timing display median[IQR] over 5 repetitions.
- **REQ-1964 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Generalization Results` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: rows five methods×two secondary scenarios; columns target F1/gain, supported harm, benign FAR increase, MAR/LAR, paired effect vs FedSIRA, adjusted p, materiality pass; footnote label `Data/Attack Generalization Only`.
- **REQ-1965 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Statistical Summary` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: one row per predeclared comparison; columns claim, comparison, metric, direction, margin, n pairs, mean difference, median difference, paired d_z, raw p, Holm p, 95% CI, material threshold, statistical pass, materiality pass, final comparison state.
- **REQ-1966 — §33.1–33.2 — Reporting:** Required manuscript table `Claim Support` must implement exactly this schema/ordering/content contract: one row per manuscript claim; columns claim, exact scope, evidence experiments, primary metric, required comparison, claim state, supporting table, supporting figure, valid scope, forbidden extrapolation.
- **REQ-1967 — §33.2 Primary Results — Reporting:** Primary Results must aggregate with equal seed weight after seed-level domain aggregation; raw method summaries show mean ± sample SD while claim-bearing differences use 95% bootstrap CIs.
- **REQ-1968 — §33.2 Source-Exclusion Results — Reporting:** Source-Exclusion Results must order FedSIRA first, then methods by increasing ASR.
- **REQ-1969 — §33.3 — Reporting:** Tables must use Section 18.10 formatting; significance must be shown by numeric raw/adjusted p-values with significance stars disabled.
- **REQ-2205 — §33 — Reporting:** Mandatory manuscript table names, semantics, columns, ordering, and scientific content are fixed by Section 33 and must not be represented as user-configurable YAML report definitions.

## Non-Negotiable Implementation Contracts

The implementation must preserve exactly, where defined by the roadmap:

- roadmap-defined algorithmic semantics;
- formulas, thresholds, equality semantics, tolerances, and numerical conventions;
- configuration authority and ownership;
- dataset, split, eligibility, chronology, and preprocessing semantics;
- experiment coordinates, controls, comparators, seeds, and statistical procedures;
- deterministic and reproducibility requirements;
- failure, unavailable, infeasible, insufficient-evidence, suppression, and abstention semantics;
- artifact, integrity, completion, and provenance requirements;
- scientific claim boundaries.

Do not introduce:

- undocumented defaults;
- hidden fallbacks;
- alternative algorithms or scientific behavior;
- post-hoc scientific choices;
- duplicated scientific constants;
- silent compatibility behavior;
- agent-invented values or assumptions.

# M08 — I52 Generate Mandatory Manuscript Figures from Verified Evidence

## Issue Summary

- **Milestone:** M08 — Claims, Reporting, and Reproducibility Closure
- **Primary deliverable:** Implement every required FedSIRA manuscript figure with exact encodings and verified artifact-backed data sources.
- **Issue type:** Reporting

## Roadmap Authority

### Roadmap Sections

- §34

### Requirements

- **Implementation requirements:** REQ-1970–REQ-1984; REQ-2206
- **Preserved non-implementation constraints:** None.

Every scope item, acceptance criterion, required output, and claim-bearing behavior in this issue traces to the roadmap authority and inventory requirements listed above or to prerequisite implementation strictly necessary to satisfy them.

## Objective

Implement every required FedSIRA manuscript figure with exact encodings and verified artifact-backed data sources.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-1970 — §34 — Reporting:** Every required figure must be generated from verified machine-readable result/statistical data with no manual transcription.
- **REQ-1971 — §34 — Reporting:** Experiment-owned figures must be placed under the experiment figures subtree; cross-experiment figures under project-summary figures subtree; exact filenames are implementation choices.
- **REQ-1972 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `FedSIRA Protocol Schematic` must satisfy: deterministic schematic showing source commitment zero weight → fixed claim contract → non-source reproduction → post-commitment verifier panels → five-row external verification → Krum → final fresh gate → admission/dormancy/rejection.
- **REQ-1973 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Primary Security–Utility Tradeoff` must satisfy: paired-effect forest plot, method comparison y-axis, one file/panel per metric, target-F1/ASR/MAR effects with 95% bootstrap CI, sorted as Primary Results.
- **REQ-1974 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Useful Backdoored Source` must satisfy: scatter with x post-production ASR, y target F1, point method seed mean, 95% CI error bars, annotations target-F1 0.80 threshold and ASR direction.
- **REQ-1975 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Collapse Decision Effects` must satisfy: four-row forest for proposal/plurality/source exclusion/external verification; x each primary material effect normalized by threshold so 1.0 is material; annotate adjusted p and Survives/Removed/Central Not Supported.
- **REQ-1976 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Compromised-Reproducer Boundary` must satisfy: line plot x compromised reproducer count 0/1/2, y MAR with separate ASR file if needed, groups by attack strategy/method, 95% seed-bootstrap CI, bound annotation at 1.
- **REQ-1977 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Compromised-Verifier Boundary` must satisfy: separate final figures for false-positive MAR and false-negative LAR vs compromised count 0/1/2, groups deterministic/random diagnostic, annotate deterministic bound 1 and random exact contamination risk.
- **REQ-1978 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Evidence-Arrival State Trajectory` must satisfy: step plot by schedule with logical cycle x-axis and fraction of seeds Dormant/Verification Pending/Admitted/Expired y-axis.
- **REQ-1979 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Shared Epistemic Failure` must satisfy: line plot corruption/confound strength x-axis, clean-oracle error/admission y-axis, groups by shared failure type.
- **REQ-1980 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Capability-Granularity Boundary` must satisfy: separate grouped bars/points for false same-capability certification and per-root-cause target F1, x claim-contract granularity, groups mixture.
- **REQ-1981 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Heterogeneity Synthesis Boundary` must satisfy: separate line/point plots for LAR and worst-domain target F1 across ordered heterogeneity regimes, groups FedSIRA/one retrain/direct Krum/Krum reference.
- **REQ-1982 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Admission-Delay Decomposition` must satisfy: stacked bars method×schedule with assignment/reproduce/verify/synthesize seconds; T_evidence shown separately as logical cycles, never stacked as seconds.
- **REQ-1983 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Efficiency Profile` must satisfy: separate plots for post-evidence wall-clock runtime, communication bytes, peak GPU memory; x method; y metric; median[IQR] over timing repetitions; no inferential p-value.
- **REQ-1984 — §34 — Reporting:** Required manuscript figure `Secondary Generalization` must satisfy: paired-effect forest plot of target-F1 effect vs each predeclared simple comparator by secondary scenario with synthetic-domain limitation annotation.
- **REQ-2206 — §34 — Reporting:** Mandatory manuscript figure names, semantics, and required encodings are fixed by Section 34 and must not be represented as user-configurable YAML figure definitions.

## Objective

Implement the reference-register traceability, third-party reconstruction/manuscript-readiness contract, and cross-project implementation-completion gate required before final scientific reporting.

## Scope

Implement only the following roadmap/inventory requirements. Each bullet is an explicit implementation obligation; none may remain implicit in tests or downstream work.

- **REQ-2036 — §39 — Reproducibility:** A third party must be able to reproduce the study from reconstruction commit, complete dependency lock, producer fingerprints, exact raw identities, schema-validated `configs/fedsira.yaml`, fixed Sections 9–13 deterministic contracts, descriptive CLI sequence, Section 30 plan, and immutable upstream identities.
- **REQ-2037 — §39 — Reproducibility:** Reproducibility traceability must detect dataset/split, configuration, seed, material producer-code/runtime, cell-phase, and upstream-artifact mismatches while distinguishing unrelated repository/dependency changes.
- **REQ-2039 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when all Section 30 cells have valid scientific terminal states including prescribed Abstain/Dormant/Rejected/Expired/null/boundary outcomes.
- **REQ-2040 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when Section 31 count invariant and Section 37 completeness verification are satisfied.
- **REQ-2041 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when required metrics, statistics, effects, CIs, multiplicity, and materiality decisions exist.
- **REQ-2042 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when every scientific invariant and leakage barrier passes.
- **REQ-2043 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when every active artifact lineage is complete, hash-valid, dependency-compatible, and has no active stale descendants.
- **REQ-2044 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when final claim states are mechanically determined by Section 35.
- **REQ-2045 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when every manuscript-facing number is traceable to fixed scientific lineage.
- **REQ-2046 — §39 — Reproducibility:** The study may be considered manuscript-reporting ready only when all Section 33–34 products can be generated without manual scientific-value transcription.
- **REQ-2065 — §42 — Testing:** Implementation readiness requires the single schema-validated config to supply every true configuration datum and every fixed scientific/execution rule to be implemented from its authoritative roadmap section without hidden defaults.
- **REQ-2066 — §42 — Testing:** Implementation readiness requires preprocessing and smoke validation to pass.
- **REQ-2067 — §42 — Testing:** Every Section 16 baseline and Section 30 experiment must be executable without inventing a scientific choice.
- **REQ-2068 — §42 — Artifact:** The stage artifact DAG and producer dependency scopes from Sections 25–27 must be implemented.
- **REQ-2069 — §42 — Reproducibility:** Completed reruns must be idempotent; compatible expensive artifacts must be reused across cells/experiments; stale descendants automatically excluded; recovery resume at nearest valid artifact; overwrite/recovery must not duplicate scientific observations.
